tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /gzungs grwa lnga'i mngon dkyil nag 'gros ma yid ches khungs thub bzhugs so// bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha dbyer med pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bde gshegs so so'i yum du gyur pas rgyal ba kun gyi rjes 'brang ma/ /'gro ba so so'i skyabs su gyur pas 'gro ba'i rjes 'brang skyob mdzad cing / /bdud bgegs so so 'joms phyir bdud rnams rjes 'brangs dang bcas 'dul mdzad pa'i/ /bcom ldan 'das ma so sor 'brang ma'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /mthing zhun ltar mdzes stong pa'i ye shes chen pos bdag 'dzin rab tu 'joms/ /rma bya lta bu'i dug lnga'i zas can bde chen lha mo gser mdog ma/ /gsang ba'i dga' bde'i sngags kyis chags can sna tshogs rjes su 'dzin mdzad cing / /'dod pa'i mes gdung skyes bu bsil mdzad bde ba'i tshal chen ldan la 'dud/ /ye shes lnga yi rang bzhin srung ba lnga'i/ /sgo nas snod ldan slob ma'i phung khams lnga'i/ /bar chad sel dang 'gro kun sku lnga yi/ /go 'phang thob phyir grwa lnga'i phyag len bri/ /de la dbang bskur sngon 'gro dkyil 'khor ba/ /zhes dang / ri mor gnas pa'i las dang ni/ /thig las tshon bkye'i rim pa bstan/ /ces pa'i rjes su 'brangs nas/ ras bris la brten pa'i cho ga dang / rdul tshon la brten pa'i cho ga'i rnam gzhag gnyis/ rje bla ma dam pa'i zhal snga nas kyis phyag len bzhin bri bar bya'o/ /de la dang po'i dbang du byas na gsum/ sbyor ba rten dang / mchod gtor bsham tshul/ dngos gzhi/ bdag mdun bum pa sgrub mchod bdag dang slob ma la dbang bskur tshul/ rjes lhag chad kha skong ba'i cho ga dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ 'os par gyur pa'i gnas byi dor legs par byas pa'i sar/ las kyi rdo rjes ras la sogs pa'i gzhi bzang po'i gdan la/ me tog sil ma gtor/ de'i steng du grwa'i ras bris rab gnas can zhal shar du phyogs par dgram/ de'i mtha' nas phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad du 'jim pa las rang grub bzos pa'am med na brtag dgos/ le ma mdzub gang tsam brgyad bzhag pa la/

mda' brgyad gzug cing / de la tshon skud sna lnga'i drwa ba bya ste/ de yang dang po dbang ldan gyi mda'i rtsa ba la tshon skud kyi sne mo btags la/ de shar gyi mda'i rtse mor khyer nas dkris/ de bzhin du shar lho'i rtsa ba dang / lho'i rtse mo dang / lho nub kyi rtsa ba dang / nub kyi rtse mo dang / nub byang gi rtsa ba dang / byang gi rtse mo dang / de ka nas byang shar gyi rtse mo dang / shar gyi rtsa ba dang / shar lho'i rtse mo dang / lho'i rtsa ba dang / lho nub kyi rtse mo dang / nub kyi rtsa ba dang / nub byang gi rtse mo dang / byang gi rtsa ba dang / byang shar gyi rtse mo dang / de nas shar gyi rtse dang / de nas mda' gnyis gnyis bor te/ lho nub kyi rtse la dkris/ de bzhin du byang gi rtse dang / shar lho'i rtse dang / nub kyi rtse dang / byang shar gyi rtse dang / lho'i rtse dang / nub byang gi rtse dang / shar gyi rtse dang / de nas rim bzhin du/ shar lho/ lho/ lho nub/ nub/ nub byang / byang gi rtse rnams la dkris re byas nas 'khor lor bskor ba'i lhag ma byang shar gyi mda'i rtsa bar drangs bzhag pas phyogs mtshams steng 'og kun tu 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa'i rnam par 'byung ngo / /de nas mda' de dag gi rtse la/ phyogs skyong so so'i kha dog can gyi lda ldi'am/ 'phan kha dog sna tshogs bskon/ bcu yod na steng 'og gi gnyis shar nub kyi rtse la'o/ /me long brgyad/ rma bya'i mdongs brgyad kyang rtser gzug rgyal chen bzhi'i tsakli gtor ma phyogs su bkod na de dag gi rtse la bzhugs pa'i phyag len dang / phyi rol du tho gzug byed par bshad pa rnams la dgongs nges yin pas de'i phyir bris pa las 'dir med kyang chog gsungs/ gal te yod na da lta gtor ma gral ring la phyogs gcig mdzad pas phyogs so so'i mda'i rtse la bskon la bzhugs/ phyi ngos nas dkyil 'khor la yar gzhal ba'i mda' brgyad kyi rtsa bar/ g.yas su phur pa brgyad/

g.yon du ral gri brgyad rnams gzug go /de'i shar du mtshams 'dzin gyi me tog 'dir mtshams 'dzin gyi me tog mdzad/ gzhan du ni mchod yon 'go brtsams pa phyag len no/ /shar du mchod yon/ shar lhor zhabs bsil/ lhor me tog lho nub tu bdug spos/ nub tu mar me/ nub byang du dri chab/ byang du zhal zas rnams bsham mo/ /shar ngos kyi mdun du cog rtse'i khar/ bdag bskyed bum pa/ sbyin sreg sogs la/ spyir mchod pa tshar gcig bsham/ dkyil 'khor gyi g.yas su gtor 'go yang mdun bskyed kyi g.yas la byas pa'i bris sku'i stod ngos nas bzung / dang po gtso mo lnga la dkar gtor gcig rnam sras la dkar gtor/ mgon po dang lha mo la dmar gtor gnyis/ phyogs skyong bcu la dkar gtor gcig rgyal po bzhi la shar du zho dang 'o ma can/ lhor nya dang khrag sha can/ nub tu zho dang 'o ma can/ yi ge 'ga' zhig la khrag zer ba'ang 'dug byang du shing thog sna tshogs can/ steng 'og gnyis la dkar gtor gnyis/ gza' skar la dkar gtor gnyis/ gsang sngags rjes 'dzin las bshad pa'i dkar gtor gnyis/ dmar gtor lnga/ klu dang 'byung po gzhi bdag gsum la dkar gtor gsum ste nyer gsum po gral la gshibs pa'o/ /de rnams bon po'i sho lu bzhin ma yin pa/ pad+ma'i snying po lta bu'i zlum gtor du bya zhing / de dag la 'bru sna tshogs dang / dkar gsum dmar gsum khur ba sogs bza' ba dang bca' ba ci 'byor gyis brgyan/ sde dpon lta bu'i stobs kyis 'byor na re re bzhin ba dan dkar po re re yang gzug go /sngon 'gro gtor ma dkar gtor dang / bgegs gtor dmar gtor zur du bshams te gtor ma nyi shu rtsa lnga'o/ /mdun bskyed kyi shar phyogs su slob dpon gyi gdan bshams de'i mdun du cog rtse'i khar/ bum pa gcig mgul chings kha rgyan rdzas nyi shu rtsa lnga/ dung chos gzungs thag dang bcas pa yang gu gul gyis bdugs/

yungs dkar gyis brab nas/ tshul bzhin bshams/ me long la/ gur gum gyi khu ba 'o mas byas nas/ ma ṇi dha ri swā hā'i gong du phyi lañcha'i praṃ gyi rnam pa de'i khog par/ che ge mo la rak+ṣa rak+ṣa ku ru/ shān+tiṃ puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru zhes bris pa dar gyis mi phyed par kha brgyan la bcings/ sngon 'gro gtor ma me tog nas rnams bzhag gzhan yang ral gri so ma dang / sbyin sreg gi rdzas 'bru sna tshogs dang / spos sna tshogs bsres pa dang / khrus long / khrus ras gu gul nag po/ bsngags pa'i yungs kar me tog nas/ rol mo'i bye brag slob ma du yod kyi grangs dang mnyam pa'i tshon skud sna lnga nyis khug tu byas pa'i lus tshad dang mnyam pa dang / glud zan dang / khrus sder dang / ku sha/ rma bya'i mdongs/ pho rog gi dang sgro/ yungs dkar gyi thum bu/ me long / ral gri/ dar tshon kha dog sna lnga ste rdzas bdun ldan gyis byab srung dang / rdzas kyis bsrung ba'i zas/ bu ram/ sbrang rtsi/ til/ sha/ nya sha ste lnga la bsil ba'i tshal nas zas ngan par bshad pas/ de lnga ma yin pa'i zho dang / 'o ma/ 'bras zan sogs dkar gsum gyi zas dang bcas pa yang sta gon bya/ shar phyogs su sa stegs gru bzhi'am/ me slang sogs kyi nang du/ rdul tshon gyis zhi ba'i thab khung bris pa'i dbus su/ sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab brgyad de'i dbus dang phyogs bzhir lha mo lnga'i sa bon kha dog dang mthun pa/ mtshams bzhir bum pa mgul chings kha rgyan dang bcas pa bris pa'i steng nas/ seng ldeng ngam rgya shug sogs shin skam pa'i shing sor bcu gnyis dang mthe'u chung gi tshad du byas pa'i/ slob ma mang nyung gi dbang gis thog rgya gram can lnga nas bcu la sogs par brtsigs la mdun ngos kyi 'og bar yang rim pa gnyis tsam bzhag pa'i lce lde 'gro sa bya/ de dag gi bar bar du me 'bar byed kyi ras snum la sbangs pa tho re ba bzhag de dang nye bar lce lde gnyis sam gcig bzhag ste de dag ni sbyor ba'i chos so/

/gnyis pa sgrub mchod dngos la/ gso sbyong blangs la zhes gsungs pas/ len par 'dod na 'og tu ston la/ 'dir ni slob dpon gyi khyim pa yin na nges par blangs dgos/ dge slong dge tshul khrims ldan la gso sbyong min pas blangs kyang rung / bsrung rgyu zur pa med pas ma blangs kyang rung gsungs shing / dkar gsum la brten pa dang / sgog btsong sogs spangs pa'i gtsang sbra ni mdzad do/ /de la ji skad bshad pa'i mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i slob dpon gyis khrus byas/ stan bde ba la 'dug nas/ dril bu gsil zhing / phyag 'tshal skyes bu dpa' khyod la/ /phyag 'tshal skyes bu mchog khyod la/ /thal mo sbyar te phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos rgyal khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /stong chen sangs rgyas spyod yul mtha' yas khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bden pa rab ston thub pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bden pa'i stobs kyis 'gro ba ma lus sgrol mdzad pa/ /bdag gi bya ba thams cad 'bras bu mchis par mdzod/ /oṃ swa bhā wa sogs brjod la stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang / raṃ las nyi ma'i steng du rang gi sems nyid yi ge hūm̐ sngon po las 'od zer 'phro 'du yongs su gyur pa las/ bdag nyid gshin rje gshed sku mdog char sprin ltar sngo ba/ zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ khro gnyer g.yo bas 'jigs pa'i zhal/ mgrin pa hūm̐ gis sgras gang ba/ ljags 'gril zhing mche ba gtsigs pa/ smin ma dang / sma ra dang / dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa/ spyan gsum dmar la zlum pa/ stag lpags kyi sham thabs can/ sbom zhing thung la gsus pa che ba/ klu dga' bo dang rigs ldan nag pos dbu skra bcings pa/ rak+ṣa ka ser pos rna rgyan/ pad chen ser pos lag gdub/ karko ṭa dmar pos mchod phyir thogs/ ba su ka dmar pos ske rags/ pad+ma dang dung skyong ku mut+ta'i mdog lta bus zhabs gdub byas pa/ nyi ma'i 'od zer gyi mdangs chen pos nam mkha' ma lus par khyab pa/

bde byed log pa'i dregs pa can thams cad 'joms par mdzad pa/ phyag g.yas gsum na 'khor lo ral gri gtun shing / g.yon gsum na gri gug satwa re zhags pa bsnams pa/ g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis ma he'i rwa bar dang tshang ra'i steng nas brdzis shing / bskal pa'i me dpung ltar 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin pa āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas rang 'dra'i ye shes pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ nyer mchod dang / oṃ ya mān+ta ka badz+ra puṣ+pe pra tīts+tsha āḥhūm̐ sogs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho/ dam tshig pa dang ye shes pa dbyer med du gyur/ yang hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros dbang gi lha rnams ā+oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ puṣ+pe pra tīts+tsha āḥhūm̐ sogs kyis mchod/ oṃ ā bhi ṣiñca tu maṃ/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa mā ya shri hūm̐/ dbang bskur sku gang dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las rdo rje sems dpas dbu brgyan/ gong bzhin nyer mchod dang / sku yi rigs gyur gshin rje gshed/ /char sprin ltar gnag 'jigs pa'i gzugs/ /dregs pa can rnams 'dul mdzad pa'i/ /rab gtum khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'i hūm̐ yig gi mthar/ oṃ ā kro te ka ya mān+ta ka hūm̐ phaṭaḥ gsum/ ces pas bskor ba sngags de nyid nyer gcig sogs bzlas/ de nas sngon 'gro gtor ma la chab gtor nas/ oṃ badz+ra mchod pa'i phyag rgyas ma dag pa'i dri ma bsangs/ yak+ṣa hūm̐ gsum/ oṃ badz+ra rdo rje me'i phyag rgyas dag pa'i dngos por sbyangs/ dz+wa la a na la ha na da ha pa tsa ma tha bhañca ra ṇa hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharma naṃ ad+ya nut+pan+na twat+ta/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gsum/ rdo rje bsdams pa 'debs pa'i phyag rgyas 'dod yon lngar byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che'i nang du/ gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs par gyur/

oṃ sarba bigh+nān sogs gsum/ nyer mchod oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe pra tīts+tsha āḥhūm̐ sogs kyis mchod/ de nas mtshams bcad pa ni/ thog mar dril bu gsil zhing / dus gsum du rnam par bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang / nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dge 'dun la phyag 'tshal lo/ /yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa bdun po dag la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jig rten na dgra bcom pa dag la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byams pa la sogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyir mi 'ong ba rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lan gcig phyir 'ong ba rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyun du zhugs pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jig rten na yang dag par song ba rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /yang dag par zhugs pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de dag la phyag 'tshal nas/ cho ga 'di la sbyar bar bya'o/ /de nas slob ma gcig yin na 'di gnyis yin na 'di dang / gsum phan la 'di rnams zhes pa'i rnam dbye kun tu shes par byas la/ slob ma 'di rnams la zhes sogs dus/ dril gsil re byed cing / rdo rje slob ma 'di rnams la rig sngags 'di grub par gyur cig 'byung po'i tshogs gang dag sa la rgyu ba rnams dang / nam mkha' la rgyu ba rnams dang / rnams dang zhes pa 'og ma kun la'ang sbyar ro/ /chu la rgyu ba/ lha/ klu/ lha ma yin/ rlung lha/ nam mkha' lding / dri za/ mi'am ci/ lto 'phye chen po/ gnod sbyin/ srin po/ yi dwags/ sha za/ 'byung po/ grul bum/ srul po/ lus srul po/ skem byed/ smyo byed/ grib gnon/ brjed byed/ gnon po rnams bdag la nyon cig 'byung po'i tshogs gzi brjid 'phrog pa rnams dang / rnams dang zhes 'og ma rnams la'ang sbyar la/ zas su mngal za ba/ zas su khrag za ba/ zas su zhag za ba/ zas su sha za ba/ zas su tshil za ba/

zas su rkang༞ zas su btsas pa༞ srog 'phrog pa༞ zas su gtor ma༞ zas su phreng ba༞ zas su dri za༞ zas su bdug pa༞ zas su me tog༞ zas su 'bras bu༞ zas su lo tog༞ zas su sbyin sreg༞ zas su rnag 'thung ba༞ zas su phyi sa༞ zas su gcin 'thung ba༞ zas su lhag ma༞ zas su mchil ma༞ zas su ngar snabs༞ zas su mi gtsang ba༞ zas su skyugs pa༞ zas su gtor khung nas 'bab pa 'thung ba༞ sdig pa'i sems dang ldan pa༞ drag shul gyi sems dang ldan pa༞ gzhan gyi srog 'phrog pa rnams bdag la nyon cig srung ba lnga'i cho ga 'di bsgrub par bya'o/ /spos dang me tog dang bdug pa dang gtor ma yang sbyin no/ /gtor ma dang mchod pa 'dis mgu bar gyis la/ ming 'di zhes bya ba'i rdo rje slob ma 'di rnams la sdig pa'i sems dang ldan pa rnams dang / /sdang ba'i sems dang ldan pa rnams dang / /drag shul gyi sems dang ldan pa rnams dang / /gzhan gyi srog 'phrog pa rnams dang / /gzi byin 'phrog pa'i gdon thams cad dengs shig /'byung po dang gnod sbyin gang su dag /zhi ba'i sems dang ldan pa rnams dang / /byams pa'i sems dang ldan pa rnams dang / /dge ba'i sems dang ldan pa rnams dang / /sangs rgyas dang chos dang dge 'dun la mngon par dad pa rnams bdag la nyon cig 'di lta ste/ nag mo bzhin sgyur ma rnams dang / 'og ma rnams la'ang / rnams zhes sbyar la/ grul bum ma/ dung chen ma/ me tog ka ma la lta bu'i mig can ma/ 'phrog ma/ sku mdog ljang gu ma/ dpal ldan ma/ spre'u ltar dmar ser ma/ 'phyang ma/ rab tu 'phyang ma/ dus kyi zhags pa can ma/ bum lto ma/ gshin rje'i pho nya mo/ 'byung po sha za ba mo rnams/ me tog dang bdug pa dang / dri dang gtor ma 'bul gyis bzhes la/ 'jigs pa dang gnod pa thams cad las ming 'di zhes bgyi ba la/ rdo rje slob ma 'di rnams la/ bsrung du gsol/ lo brgya 'tsho bar gyur cig ston brgya mthong bar gyur cig ming 'di zhes bya ba la rig sngags kyi gzhi rnams grub par gyur cig swā hā/

zhes dang / slob dpon gyis ku sha'i chus lam phyed oṃ a kro te ka sogs khro bo'i sngags brjod/ rol mo drag po dang bcas gtor ma dor ro/ /de nas mchod pa rnams/ yak+ṣas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ oṃ dpag tu med pa zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo la sogs pa mchod rdzas kyi bye brag ji snyed yod pa thams cad rang bzhin stong pa rnam pa mchod yon la sogs pa mchod rdzas so sor snang ba ngo bo zag pa med pa'i bde ba khyad par can skyed nus pa'i ye shes kyi rang bzhin can 'phags pa kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin phung ltar bzang zhing rgya che ba nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa bla ma dang rje btsun ma so sor 'brang ma srung ba lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi spyan lam du 'byung zhing rgyas par gyur cig oṃ sarba bid pū ra pū ra su ra su ra a brta ya a brta ya ho/ oṃ badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin du/ pād+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhūpe/ ā lo ke gan+dhe/ nai wi te/ shap+ta pra tits+tsha āḥhūm̐ dang / mchod pa'i sprin sngags dang / dharma ra ṇi ta'i sngags brjod/ de nas/ bdag dang 'gro ba nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad gcig tu bsdus pa'i ngo bo chos kyi phung po stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i 'byung gnas/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun thams cad kyi mnga' bdag sku bzhi ye shes lnga'i bdag nyid can drin can rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/

/sangs rgyas la༞ chos la༞ dge 'dun la༞ bla ma la sogs nyer gcig bla ma sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog rnams la/ /byang chub ma thob bar du bdag nyid skyabs su mchi/ /bdag gis sgom bzlas bgyis pa'i bsod nams 'di dag gis/ /'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas myur tu 'grub par shog /gsum/ rang gi spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ snying khar hūm̐/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rak+ṣa rak+ṣa phaṭa swāhā/ gsum/ rang gi snying kha'i pad mar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rang gi sems nyid yi ge praṃ dkar la ser ba'i mdangs chags pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ bla ma dang sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ sangs rgyas byang sems rnams srung ba lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi rnam par gyur/ bla ma rnams gcig tu 'dus nas rigs bdag gi tshul du bzhugs par gyur/ lus kyis phyag 'tshal bar bsam zhing / ngag tu/ bla ma rnams dang rje btsun so sor 'brang ma dang / stong chen rab 'joms/ de bzhin rma bya chen mo dang / gsang sngags rjes 'dzin/ bsil ba'i tshal gyi lha mo rnams/ 'khor dang bcas la sgo gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes brjod cing / thugs ka nas spros pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod par gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pañca rak+ṣa de ba tsakra maṇ+ḍal sa pa rī wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha pu dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ zhes pa'i mchod yon dang / de bzhin du ar+ghaṃ gyi gnas su/ pād+yaṃ gis zhabs bsil/ puṣ+pes me tog dhū pes bdug spos/ ā lo kes mar me/ gan+dhes dri chab/ nai wi d+yas zhal zas/ shap+tas rol mo phul la/ bla ma dang ni lha mo lnga'i sku rnams la/ /me tog dag dang spos la sogs pas mchod par bgyi/ /lus dang ngag dang rab tu dang ba'i sems kyis ni/ /rnam mang sdig pa bgyis pa dag ni 'chags bgyid cing / /de dag rnams la skyabs su nye bar mchi bar bgyi/ /sangs rgyas rdzu 'phrul che dang ldan pa de dag la/

/lha gang mngon par rab tu dang ba yod pa yi/ /lha de mgu zhing yid ni rab tu dang ba'i sems kyis bdag la bsrung du gsol bsrung du gsol/ /zhes brjod la/ oṃ badz+ra mu/ tshogs rten gyi dkyil 'khor rang bzhin gyis gshegs par gyur/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par bya/ sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar bya/ sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang dus rtag tu mi 'bral bar bya/ bde sdug gi rgyu chags sdang nye ring mtha' dag dang bral nas chags sdang med pa'i ngang la sems btang snyoms par bya/ oṃ shu n+ya ta dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma ko3haṃ/ stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje shar sngo/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang / dbus dkar ba/ lte bar hūm̐ de las 'od zer rdo rje'i 'phros pas 'og tu rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ logs rnams su rdo rje'i rwa ba/ steng du rdo rje'i gur/ de'i 'og tu rdo rje'i bla re/ de'i phyi rol tu rdo rje'i drwa ba/ phyi nas ye shes kyi me 'bar bskal pa 'jig pa'i me dpung lta bu 'bar bas bskor ba'i srung 'khor gyi nang du yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor gzhu'i dbyibs can sngon po/ de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum/ de'i steng du baṃ las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po/ de'i steng du laṃ las sa'i dkyil 'khor gru bzhi ser po/ de'i steng du suṃ las ri rab thar pa chen po'i grong khyer mchog gi gnas gru bzhi pa lcog brgyad kyis mdzes pa/ de'i steng du paṃ las sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte bar hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar bh+rūṃ las gzhal yas khang / gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bzhis brgyan pa/ rin po che'i rtsig pa phyi nas rim pa bzhin sngo ser dmar ljang dkar ba'i steng nas/ rin po che'i snam bu ser po/

rin po che sna tshogs kyis spras pa/ de'i steng du chu srin ma ka ra'i kha nas 'phyang ba'i dra ba dang dra ba phyed pa/ de'i steng du bya 'dab las 'phyang ba'i rin po che'i shar bu dkar po/ de'i steng du kra ma shir+ṣa pad+ma'i 'dab ma phyed pa'i dbyibs can/ phyi rol nas 'dod yon gyi snam bu dmar po bzhis bskor ba'i steng du mchod pa'i lha mo mchod rdzas 'dzin pa/ sgo dang sgo khyud kyi mtshams su zla phyed rdo rje rin po ches brgyan cing rtse mo rdo rje dang nor bu rin po che'i tog gis spras pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i gzhal yas khang gi dbus su/ paṃ las sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte bar a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ shar gyi pad 'dab kyi steng du raṃ las nyi ma/ gzhan rnams kyi steng du a las zla ba'i gdan re re/ dbus kyi zla ba'i steng du/ praṃ dkar la ser ba'i mdangs chags pa/ shar du hūm̐ sngon po/ lhor maṃ ser po/ nub tu shaṃ dmar skya/ byang du gaṃ ljang khu/ sa bon gyi yi ge de rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ 'khor lo/ rdo rje/ mchog sbyin/ chos kyi 'khor lo'i phyag rgya/ mi 'jigs pa sbyin pa'i phyag rgya rnams sa bon gyi yi ge de dag gis mtshan par gyur/ de rnams las kyang 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ srung ba lnga'i lha tshogs kyi go 'phang la bkod/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ so so'i sku yongs su rdzogs par gyur pa ni/ lha mo lnga po cig car du bskyed la rim gyis gsal gdab bo/ /dbus su rang nyid bcom ldan 'das ma so sor 'brang ma chen mo sku mdog cung zad dkar po/ brgyad gnyis lon pa'i rnam pa can/ gtsug tor mchod rten gyis brgyan pa bdag bskyed bsdu na gzhal yas khang pa med pa'i sor 'brang ltar bskyed la bzlas so/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung du bzhugs pa/

zhal bzhi ma zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum ma/ phyag brgyad ma/ rna rgyan 'phyang ba/ mu tig gi do shal dang / zhabs la rkang gsil dang / rin po che'i ske rags dang dril bu g.yer kha dang bcas pa/ rtsa zhal cung zad dkar ser/ g.yas nag rgyab ser/ g.yon dmar ba/ g.yas kyi phyag bzhi na 'khor lo/ mda'/ ral gri/ g.yon bzhi na/ rdo rje'i zhags pa/ rtse gsum/ gzhu/ dgra sta 'dzin pa/ rin po che sna tshogs pas brgyan pa/ dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' bklubs pa/ nyi ma'i rgyab yol can/ lo ma dang me tog dang 'bras bu du mas spras pa'i byang chub kyi shing drung du bzhugs pa'o/ /shar du stong chen rab 'joms sku mdog sngon mo/ nyi ma'i gdan la/ zhabs brkyang ste rol pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ zhal bzhi phyag brgyad ma rtsa zhal sngon mo/ g.yas dkar/ rgyab ser g.yon dmar ba/ dbu re re la dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ zhal la la mche ba gtsigs shing / la la rab tu gdangs nas ljags 'gril ba/ smin ma'i dbus na khro gnyer bsdus pa/ g.yas kyi phyag bzhis rdo rje dang bcas pa'i mchod sbyin/ lcags kyu/ mda'/ ral gri/ g.yon bzhi na/ zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub/ dgra sta/ gzhu/ pad+ma'i steng na rin po che zur drug pa 'dzin pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal dang / rus pa dang rin po che'i gdu bu dang / dpung rgyan dang / mu tig gi do shal dang / g.yer khas spras pa/ sbrul gyi rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ rab tu khros pa drag mo'i tshul can/ ta la'i sdong po rab tu rgyas pa'i shing drung na ye shes kyi me dpung rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /lhor rma bya chen mo gser gyi mdog can/ zhabs sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ zhal gsum phyag brgyad ma/ rtsa zhal ser mo/ g.yas nag g.yon dmar ba/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/

g.yas kyi phyag bzhi na mchog sbyin dang / rin po che'i rgyun babs pa'i bum pa dang / 'khor lo/ ral gri/ g.yon bzhi na/ dge slong dang bcas pa'i lhung bzed dang / rma bya'i mjug sgro dang / sna tshogs rdo rjes kha brgyan pa'i bum pa/ rin po che'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa/ rin po che sna tshogs pas brgyan cing / dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' bklubs pa/ nyi ma'i rgyab yol can/ mya ngan med pa'i shing drung na bzhugs pa'o/ /nub tu gsang sngags rjes 'dzin ma pad ma rā ga ltar dmar ba/ zhabs skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ gzhon nu dar la babs pa/ zhal gsum phyag bcu gnyis ma/ rtsa zhal dmar/ g.yas nag g.yon dkar ba/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis chos kyi 'khor lo'i phyag rgya/ de 'og gnyis ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgya/ g.yas kyi phyag lhag ma bzhi na/ mi 'jigs pa dang mchog sbyin dang rdo rje/ mda'/ g.yon gyi lhag ma bzhi na/ sdigs mdzub zhags pa dang bcas pa dang / pad+mas brgyan pa'i bum pa dang / rin po che'i snye ma dang / gzhu 'dzin pa/ rin po che'i cod pan dang / mgul rgyan dang / gdu bu dang / dpung rgyan dang / mu tig do shal dang / rin po che sna tshogs pas spras pa/ dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' can/ nyi ma'i rgyab yol la brten pa/ shi ri sha'i shing drung na bzhugs pa'o/ /byang du bsil ba'i tshal chen mo margad ltar ljang ba zhabs sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ zhal gsum phyag drug ma/ rtsa zhal ljang khu/ g.yas dkar/ g.yon dmar ba/ g.yas kyi phyag gsum na/ mi 'jigs pa sbyin pa'i phyag rgya/ rdo rje/ mda'/ g.yon gsum na zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub dang / rin po che'i rgyal mtshan dang / gzhu 'dzin pa/ rin po che sna tshogs kyis spras shing / dar sna tshogs kyi na bzas bklubs pa/ nyi ma'i rgyab yol can tsam pa ka'i shing drung na bzhugs pa'o/ /mtshams kyi 'dab ma bzhi la ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa/

mgul chings/ kha rgyan dang bcas pa bzhi'o/ /de ltar ye shes lnga'i bdag nyid kyi lha mo lnga'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs dkar hūm̐ sngon po/ snying gi nang du zla ba la gnas pa'i so so'i kha dog dang mthun pa'i sa bon de dag las 'od zer 'phros/ bsgom pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ ar+ghaṃ sogs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dam tshig pa dang ye shes pa dbyer med 'dres par gyur/ yang thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas/ dbang gi lha rgyal ba rigs lnga'i lha tshogs badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ ar+ghaṃ sogs/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñca tu maṃḥ zhes gsol ba gdab/ de bzhin gshegs pa de rnams kyis/ ji ltar bltams pa la sogs dang / oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus dbang bskur/ sgo gsum gyi dri ma bag chags dang bcas pa dag lus ye shes kyi chu rgyun gyis gang / sngags dang phyag rgya ting nge 'dzin la dbang bar byas/ chu lhag ma yar lud pa las/ rdo rje sems dpa' rigs lngas dbu brgyan par bsgom mo/ / rdo rje sems dpa' gcig pus dbu brgyan pa'ang bshad/ de ltar lha sku snang la rang bzhin med pa/ me long gi gzugs brnyan nam/ dbang po'i gzugs brnyan gzhu lta bu la yid rtse gcig tu/ mnyam par bzhag par bya'o/ /bsgom pas skyo na/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pañca rak+ṣa sogs nyer mchod kyis mchod/ rang bzhin shān+tiṃ nas dag pa nyid las byung / /rdo rje sems dpa'i bdag nyid mchog /dung dang kun+da'i 'od dang mtshungs/ /so sor 'brang mar phyag 'tshal bstod/ /kha dog nag mo mi bzad 'jigs/ /rngam zhing zhal 'gyur khro gnyer can/ /gdul dka'i 'byung po yang dag 'dul/ /rdo rje khro mor phyag 'tshal bstod/ /lha mo ye shes las byung che/ /gser gyi 'od ltar rab 'bar ba'i/

/rma bya che la rab dad pas/ /rig pa'i rgyal mor phyag 'tshal bstod/ /pad+ma kha phye'i zhal mnga' ba/ /zhal mdzes ma la spyan yangs shing / /pad+ma rā ga ltar dmar ba'i/ /'gro ba'i mar gyur phyag 'tshal bstod/ /mthing kha nam mkha'i 'od dang mtshungs/ /'dod pa'i 'dod chags kyis sgeg ma/ /dug rnams 'joms par byed pa mo/ /sku mdzes ma la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ces pas bstod la/ bzlas pa la 'jug ste/ lha so so'i thugs kha'i sa bon gyi mthar so so'i sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba/ de dag las 'od zer 'phros pas sems can thams cad kyi don byas zhi rgyas dbang drag gi phrin las ma lus pa sgrub/ sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyi thugs rje byin rlabs nus pa ma lus pa bsdus nas rang nyid la thim par gyur/ las dang mthun pa'i phreng ba 'dzin pas/ sngags bzla ba ni/ oṃ ma ṇi dha ri badz+ri ṇi ma hā pra ti sa pa ri hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ so sor 'brang ma'o/ /oṃ a mṛ te wa re wa ra wa ra pra wa ra bi shud+dhe hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ stong chen mo'o/ /oṃ a mṛ ta bi lo ki ni gar+bhe saṃ rak+ṣa ṇi ā kar+ṣa ṇi hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ rma bya chen mo'o/ /oṃ bi ma le bi pu le dza ya ba re a mṛ ta bi ra rgya dper med/ dze hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swa hā/ gsang sngags rjes 'dzin no/ /oṃ bha ra bha ra sam+bha ra sam+bha ra in+d+ra ya ba la bi sho dha ni hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa ru ru tsa le swāhā/ bsil ba'i tshal lo/ /ci 'grub bzlas nas ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin lha mo lnga'i sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs ma lus pa bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi rgyud la 'jug par mdzad nas/ mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa bstsal du gsol/ yig brgya las gsum brjod/ rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ bsrung 'khor gzhal yas khang lha mo bzhi bum pa dang bcas pa rang gi snying khar thim par gyur/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sangs rgyas rdzu 'phrul che dang ldan pa de dag la/

/lha gang mngon par rab tu dang ba yod pa yi/ /lha de mgu zhing yid ni rab tu dga' gyur nas/ /rab tu dang ba'i sems kyis bdag la srung du gsol/ /de nas bris sku'i zhal khebs bsal la/ yak+ṣa dang / bum chus bsangs/ swa bhā was stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje sogs nas/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i gzhal yas khang gi nang gi phyogs mdog shar sngo/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang / dbus dkar ba'i dbus su/ sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa ze'u 'bru dang bcas pa nyis rim/ de'i phyi rol du 'khor lo sngon po rtsibs brgyad pa/ de'i phyi rol du lha snam zlum po sngon po/ stong chen ma la raṃ las nyi ma/ gzhan gtso 'khor thams cad kyi gnas su/ a las zla ba'i gdan re re grub par gyur/ dbus kyi zla ba'i steng du nas/ kha rgyan dang bcas pa bzhi'o/ /zhes ba'i bar bdag bskyed bzhin brjod/ pad+ma 'dab brgyad phyi ma'i shar gyi 'dab ma'i g.yas phyogs su pad+ma dang / ngang pa'i steng du/ oṃ las tshangs pa ser po zhal bzhi pa/ phyag bzhi'i g.yas pad+ma dang bgrang phreng / g.yon spyi blug dang glegs baṃ 'dzin pa g.yon du pad+ma dang glang po che'i steng du/ oṃ las brgya sbyin ser po spyan stong ldan/ g.yas rdo rje/ g.yon du sdigs mdzub/ lho'i 'dab ma la pad+ma dang ma he'i steng du yaṃ las gshin rje nag po/ g.yas dbyug to/ /g.yon thod pa 'dzin pa/ nub tu pad+ma dang chu srin gyi steng du baṃ las chu bdag dkar po/ sbrul mgo bdun gyi gdengs ka can/ phyag gnyis sbrul zhags 'dzin pa/ byang du pad+ma dang rta'i steng du kuṃ las nor bdag ku be ra sku mdog ser po/ g.yas rin po ches mtshan pa'i be con dang / g.yon ne'u le 'dzin pa/ dbang ldan du pad+ma dang glang khyu mchog gi steng du aṃ las dbang ldan dkar po/ rtse gsum dang thod pa 'dzin pa/

mer pad+ma dang ra skyes kyi steng du raṃ las me lha dmar po phyag bzhi pa/ g.yas mchod sbyin dang dbyu gu/ g.yon bgrang phreng dang spyi blug 'dzin pa/ lho nub tu pad+ma dang ro'i steng du raṃ las srin po nag po/ ral gri dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ rlung du pad+ma dang ri dwags kyi steng du yaṃ las rlung lha ljang khu/ phyag gnyis ba dan 'dzin pa/ chu lha'i g.yas phyogs su pad+ma dang / pad+ma kha zum pa'i nang du baṃ las sa'i lha mo gser mdog g.yas dpang por khas len/ g.yon rin po che'i bum pa bsnams pa/ de thams cad kyang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ lha rdzas kyi gos kyis stod g.yogs dang / smad g.yogs byas pa/ 'od zer gyi dkyil 'khor rab tu 'bar ba'i nang na rang rang gi gdan la sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'o/ /de nas shar gyi 'khor lo'i shar gyi rtsibs steng gi g.yas su/ rtas drangs pa'i shing rta dang nyi ma'i steng du raṃ las drang srong chen po nyi ma dmar po pad+ma'i sdong po 'dzin pa gzi brjid mtha' yas pa/ g.yon du ngang pas drangs pa'i shing rta'i steng du zla ba la/ oṃ las zla ba dkar po ku mu da'i sdong bu 'dzin pa/ shin tu zhi ba'i ngang tshul can no/ /shar lho'i rtsibs la ra skyes kyi steng du raṃ las mig dmar dmar po g.yas gri gug g.yon mi mgo 'dzin pa/ gtum pa'i gzugs can no/ /lho'i rtsibs la pad+ma'i steng du bh+rūṃ las gza' lhag ljang khu/ mda' gzhu 'dzin pa/ zhi zhing mdzes pa'i ngang tshul can no/ /lho nub kyi rtsibs la glang po che'i steng du bh+ri las phur bu ser po g.yas bgrang phreng / g.yon ril ba spyi blug 'dzin pa/ brtse ba'i ngang tshul can no/ /nub kyi rtsibs la pad+ma'i steng du shaṃ las pa wa sangs dkar po g.yas shel phreng / g.yon spyi blug 'dzin pa/ sha rgyas shing bzhad pa'i ngang tshul can no/ /nub byang gi rtsibs la sbrul gyi steng du paṃ las spen pa mig sman ltar gnag pa/

g.yas bgrang phreng / g.yon dbyu gu gsum pa 'dzin pa/ 'jigs shing gtum pa'i gzugs can no/ /byang gi rtsibs la rnam par 'khyil ba'i sprin gyi steng du raṃ las sgra gcan dmar nag nyi ma dang zla ba 'dzin pa/ khro zhing brjid pa'i tshul can no/ /byang shar gyi rtsibs la brag ri brtsegs pa'i steng du kaṃ las ke ru skya sangs ral gri dang sbrul zhags 'dzin pa/ drag po'i gzugs can no/ /de'i phyi rol gyi lha rnams la dbang ldan nas g.yas bskor gyis kriṃ las smin drug sngo bsangs/ raṃ las snar ma dmar skya/ mṛṃ las mgo nag mo/ /i las lag ser mo/ /suṃ las nabs so ser mo/ /suṃ las rgyal sngo bsangs/ oṃ las skag dkar mo/ /lho phyogs su maṃ las mchu ser mo/ /suṃ las gre ljang khu/ uṃ las dbo ljang khu/ haṃ las me bzhi dkar mo/ /tsaṃ las nags pa ljang khu/ shaṃ las sa ri ser mo/ /biṃ las sa ga nag mo/ nub phyogs su/ aṃ las lha mtshams ljang khu/ dz+yaṃ las snron ser mo/ /muṃ las snrubs ser mo/ /suṃ las chu stod nag mo/ /uṃ las chu smad dkar mo/ /shraṃ las gro bzhin dkar ser/ aṃ las byi bzhin sngo bsangs/ byang du/ dhaṃ las mon gre nag mo/ /shaṃ las mon gru ser mo/ /suṃ las khrums stod ljang khu/ uṃ las khrums smad ser mo/ /raṃ las nam gru dkar mo/ /aṃ las tha skar dkar mo/ /bhaṃ las bra nye ljang khu/ de rnams thams cad kyang lha mo stod g.yogs g.yo ba dang bcas shing phyag gnyis thal mo sbyar ba/ rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa stan nang tshang can la bzhugs pa'o/ /sgo bzhir rin po che'i khri'i steng du/ shar du dhṛ las rgyal po chen po yul 'khor srung ljang khu phyag gnyis pi waṃ bsgreng ba/ 'khor dri za'i tshogs kyis bskor ba/ lhor biṃ las 'phags skyes po sngon po/ g.yas ral gri g.yon gdan la brten pa grul bum gyi tshogs kyis bskor ba/ nub tu baṃ las mig mi bzang dmar po/

g.yas sbrul zhags dang / g.yon mchod rten 'dzin pa klu'i tshogs kyis bskor ba/ byang du bai las rgyal po rnam thos sras ser po/ g.yas rin po ches mtshan pa'i dbyug tho/ g.yon ne'u le 'dzin pa/ gnod sbyin gyi tshogs kyis bskor ba/ de rnams kyang go cha dang ya lad bgos shing / rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ thams cad kyang gtso mo la 'dud pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs pa'o/ /lha de thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ snying kha'i nang du zla ba la gnas pa'i so so'i kha dog dang mthun pa'i sa bon gyi yi ge de dag las 'od zer 'phros pas/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas/ bcom ldan 'das ma srung ba lnga'i dkyil 'khor la/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba/ mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing / /bdud sde dpung bcas mi bzad 'joms mdzad lha/ /dngos rnams ma lus ji bzhin mkhyen gyur pa'i/ /bcom ldan 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /bcom ldan bskal pa grangs med du ma ru/ /'gro la brtse phyir thugs rje rnam sbyangs nas/ /smon lam rgya chen dgongs pa yongs rdzogs pa/ /khyed bzhed 'gro don mdzad dus 'dir lags na/ /de phyir chos dbyings pho brang lhun grub nas/ /rdzu 'phrul byin rlabs sna tshogs ston mdzad cing / mtha' yas sems can tshogs rnams bsgral ba'i phyir/ /yang dag 'khor dang bcas te gshegs su gsol/ /badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ ma hā ka ru ṇi ka e h+ye/ sa ma ya satwaṃ/ zhes pas spyan drangs/ thal mo sbyar la/ bcom ldan thugs rjes byon pa legs/ /bdag cag bsod nams skal bar ldan/ /bdag gi mchod yon bzhes nas kyang / /'di nyid du ni bzhugs su gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a ha ra pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ zhes pa dang / thal mo kha phye bas mchod yon phul/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs dang /

a bhi ṣe ka tas khrus gsol/ bdag dang 'gro la thugs brtse'i phyir/ /nyid kyi rdzu 'phrul mthu yis ni/ /ji srid mchod pa bdag bgyid na/ /de srid bcom ldan bzhugs su gsol/ /pad+ma tsan+d+ra a pā na tiṣ+ṭhan+tu swāhā/ zhes pa'i gdan la bzhugs su gsol/ de la nyer mchod kyis mchod/ sngar bzhin dgug gzhug byas/ yang thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ dbang gi lha spyan drangs pa sogs sngar bzhin byas nas/ khyad par 'khor rnams la gtso mos dbu brgyan par bsam mo/ /de nas/ gtso bo lnga'i sngags dang / gzhan rnams la oṃ in+d+ra ye swāhā/ oṃ ag+na ye swāhā/ oṃ ya ma ye swāhā/ oṃ ni ri tī ye swāhā/ oṃ ba ru ṇa swāhā/ oṃ ba ya be swāhā/ oṃ ku be ra swāhā/ oṃ i shwa na swāhā/ oṃ prah+ma swāhā/ oṃ pri thi wī de wī swāhā/ phyogs skyong rnams kyi'o/ /oṃ mai golka ya swāhā/ oṃ sha taṃ sha bai swāhā/ oṃ rāk+ṣa a ga ku ma ra swāhā/ oṃ bu dhā ya swāhā/ oṃ bri ha sa te swāhā/ oṃ bhu kra swāhā/ oṃ kṛṣ+ṇa war+ṇa swāhā/ oṃ a mṛ te pri ya swāhā/ oṃ dz+yo ti ke ta ye swāhā/ gza' rnams so/ /oṃ karti ka swāhā/ oṃ ro hi nī swāhā/ oṃ mṛ ga shi rā swāhā/ oṃ ārta swāhā/ oṃ pū nar ba su swāhā/ oṃ pu sh+ya swāhā/ oṃ asme sha swāhā/ shar skar bdun gyi'o/ /oṃ ma ghā swāhā/ oṃ sūr+ya phal gu ni swāhā/ oṃ urtar phalgu ni swāhā/ oṃ hās+d+yā swāhā/ oṃ tsit+t+ra swāhā/ oṃ swasti swāhā/ oṃ bi shwa kha swāhā/ lho'o/ /oṃ a nu rārdza swāhā/ oṃ dz+yaṣ+ṭa swāhā/ oṃ mu la swāhā/ oṃ sūr+ṣa sha ṭa swāhā/ oṃ urta ra sha ṭa swāhā/ oṃ sha bā ṇā swāhā/ oṃ a bhi dzi tā swāhā/ nub kyi'o/ /oṃ dha niṣ+ṭa swāhā/ oṃ sha ta bhi ṣā swāhā/ oṃ surba bhā dra pa dā swāhā/ oṃ ut+ta ra bha dra pā dā swāhā/ oṃ re waṃ ti swāhā/ oṃ a shī ni swāhā/

oṃ bha ra ṇī swāhā/ byang gi'o/ /oṃ dh+riṣ+ṭa raṣ+ṭa ya swāhā/ oṃ bi ru dha kā swāhā/ oṃ bi ru bak+ṣa ya swāhā/ oṃ bai shra bā ṇāya swāhā/ sngags rnams bdun bdun bzlas la/ dkyil 'khor byin gyis brlab bo/ /de nas sngar bshams pa ma grub na 'dir bum pa gcig legs par bshams la/ yak+ṣas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang / a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ baṃ las rin po che'i bum pa lto ba yangs pa/ mchu 'phyang ba/ mgrin pa ring ba kha khyer dang ldan pa/ gtsang ba dang nag nog med pa/ mgrin pa ras dkar po zung gis nyis rim du dkris pa'i nang du/ oṃ tāb+te tāb+te ma hā tāb+te ye swāhā/ lha'i dal 'gro'i chu brgyad ldan dang / rin po che lnga/ sman lnga/ 'bru lnga/ dri lnga/ snying po lnga rnams kyis yongs su gang zhing / oṃ kalpa bṛk+ṣa ye swāhā/ dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa/ phyi bum pa'i rnam pa la/ nang bh+rūṃ las ye shes kyi gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sogs nas/ 'khor rnams la gtso mo nyid kyis dbu brgyan par gyur/ ces pa'i bar mdun bskyed kyi skabs ltar brjod/ de nas mchod bstod bum mdun phyogs gcig tu mdzad pas/ spos dang mar me sogs sbar la/ mchod pa bsangs sbyangs byin brlab bya/ dbyangs dang bcas pa'am med kyang rung ste/ rdo rje thal mo kha phye ba'i phyag rgya dang / oṃ bde bar gshegs so bcom ldan 'das/ /tshur gshegs 'dir ni bzhugs su gsol/ /bdag gi mchod yon bzhes nas kyang / /thugs kyis thugs dpag mdzad du gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā sogs mtshan sngags la mchod yon gyi sngags dang bcas tshogs zhing gi mchod pa'i skabs bzhin gyi mchod yon dang / de bzhin du zhabs bsil nas/ rol mo'i bar la'ang / mtshan sngags la mchod pa so so'i sngags sbyar/ g.yas pa'i rdo rje khu tshur gyi mtheb mdzub kyis zhabs bsil gyi snod nas me tog blangs te/

'bul ba'i tshe na sor mo lhag ma rnams brkyang ste dbul ba dang / sngar gyi tshigs bcad la mchod yon gyi gnas su/ zhabs bsil zhes pa bcug la zhabs bsil dang / gtsang zhing gtsang mar sbyar skyes pa'i/ /lha rdzas dam pa'i me tog 'di/ /bdag gis dad pas 'bul lags kyi/ /bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ /kyis me tog nags tshal bcud ni yid du 'ong / /dri yis sbyar ba lha yi rdzas/ /bdag gis dad pas 'bul lags kyi/ /bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ kyis bdug spos/ gdon rnams 'joms shing bkra shis pa/ /dge zhing mun pa rnam sel 'di/ /bdag gis dad pas 'bul lags kyis/ /bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod kyis mar me/ gtsang zhing gtsang ma las byung ba'i/ /lha rdzas bzang po'i dri 'di dag /bdag gis dad pas 'bul lags kyi/ /bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod kyis dri mchog sman rnams bcud ni yid gar 'ong / /sngags kyi zhal zas bshos 'di dag /bdag gis dad pas 'bul lags kyis/ /bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod kyis zhal zas/ de rnams kyi sngags dang phyag rgya byas la 'bul lo/ /de las gzhan yang mchod pa'i tshogs/ /rol mo dbyangs snyan yid 'ong ldan/ /sems can sdug bsngal sel byed pa'i/ /sprin rnams so sor gnas gyur cig /ces dang dril gsil rol chen mchod sprin gyi sngags brjod/ de nas 'dod yon lnga 'bul ba ni/ kha dog dbyibs legs yid 'ong rgyan phreng ldan/ /zhes sogs sam/ gzugs kyi mchod pa khyad par che/ /sgra yi mchod pa yid 'ong ldan/ /dri yi mchod pa tshim pa'i mchog /ro yi mchod pa bla na med/ /reg bya'i mchod pa bde mchog dang / /mchod pa rnam pa lnga rnams kyis/ /rab 'byams zhing gi yongs bkang ste/ /bla ma dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul/ /zhes pa dang / sngags gyis ar+ghaṃ gyi gnas su/ rū pa/ shap+ta/ gan+dhe/ rā sa/ par+ṣe/ rnams re re la kā ma gu ṇa bcug la phyag dang bcas pas mchod/ de nas/

mngon par 'byung ba'i mod las byung ba'i tshigs bcad phyag rgya dang bcas pa'i/ gser las legs byas lte ba shin tu zlum/ /rtsibs stong ldan zhing mu khyud ma nyams bzang / /dang por sa la rnam par rgyal gyur gang / /'khor lo rin chen nam mkha' bkang te 'bul/ /tsakra rat+na/ rin chen dri med baiḍūr+ya'i rang bzhin/ /kun tu dpag tshad tsam du snang byed pa/ /dri med nyin mo ji bzhin mtshan de bzhin/ /nor bu rin chen nam mkha' bkang ste 'bul/ /ma ṇi rat+na/ 'gro dang kun tu gnas dang rnam ldog par/ /ma lus dpung la mkhas par byed pa yi/ /dpal ldan mi dbang rin chen bdun pa ste/ /blon po rin chen nam mkha' bkang ste 'bul/ /pa ri ṇa ya ka rat+na/ gang zhig legs dri gzugs dang mdangs ldan pa'i/ /bud med dam pa dregs ldan rnams kyi mchog /lha mo bzhin du yon tan kun ldan pa'i/ /bud med rin chen nam mkha' bkang ste 'bul/ /satri rat+na/ gang yang 'di na rgyal la mu tig dang / /gser sogs shin tu mang po phul ba yi/ /nor ldan mtshungs pa nor mang khyim bdag ni/ /rin po che ni nam mkha' bkang te 'bul/ gri ha pa ti rat+na/ yan lag thams cad legs skyes sa la ni/ /rab gnas gangs chen ri 'dra glang po ni/ /rgyal po la 'os mkha' la rab 'gro ba'i/ /glang po rin chen nam mkha' bkang ste 'bul/ hasti rat+na/ /tho rangs dus su phyogs rnams ma lus pa'i/ /sa rnams bskor nas slar ni ldog gyur gang / /rma bya'i mgrin 'dra spu ni yid 'ong ba'i/ /rta mchog rin chen nam mkha' bkang ste 'bul/ a shwa rat+na/ zhes sogs ar+ghaṃ gyi gnas su bcug pa'i/ rin chen sna bdun 'bul/ de nas/ lha yi dbang po lha min g.yul rgyal nas/ /bkra shis lha mo brgyad kyis mchod pa ltar/ /lha mo phyogs skyong gza' skar rgyal chen sogs/ /bkra shis rdzas brgyad dag gis mchod par bgyi/ /maṃ ga la aṣ+ṭa dra bya zhes pas bkra shis rdzas brgyad kyis mchod/

oṃ sarba bid pū ra nas s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ gi bar brjod/ de nas bstod pa ni/ chos rgyal 'phags pas/ gzugs phung gnas 'gyur gti mug rnam dag pa/ /me long ye shes rang bzhin lha mo'i sku/ /rgyal ba kun gyi sku yi rigs las byung / so sor 'brang ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ston zla ltar gsal zhal bzhi phyag bzhi ma/ /g.yas zhal char sprin lta bur ches gnag cing / /rgyab zhal gser mdog g.yon zhal dzā ba'i mdangs/ /gtsug tor mchod rten gyis brgyan phyag 'tshal lo/ /rin chen gyis spras bcu drug lon pa'i tshul/ /'khor lo rdo rje mda' dang ral gri g.yas/ /zhags pa rtse gsum gzhu dang dgra sta bsnams/ /g.yon gyi phyag na bsnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gdong bzhi zhi ba dga' byed gos ser can/ /mkha' lding klu dbang gnod sbyin dri za dang / /mi'am ci yi tshogs kyis gus mchod pa/ /byang chub shing drung bzhugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nyon mongs zhags pa'i 'ching ba gcod mdzad pa'i/ /gzhan gyi sngags dang phyag rgya rdzas sbyor dang / /byad stems 'byed dang drag shul las rnams kun/ /rab tu 'joms pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dkon mchog la mchod mngon par brtson pa dang / /brtse bas gzhan don gcig tu lhur len cing / /theg pa mchog gi brtul zhugs 'dzin pa rnams/ /yongs su skyong ba khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnam shes gnas gyur zhe sdang rnam dag pa/ /chos dbyings ye shes rang bzhin lha mo'i sku/ /rgyal ba kun gyi thugs kyi rigs las byung / /stong chen rab 'joms zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nam mkha'i mdangs ldan zhal bzhi phyag brgyad ma/ /g.yas zhal kun da ltar dkar rgyab zhal ser/ /g.yon zhal dmar zhing zhal rer spyan gsum ldan/ /rngam pa'i sgra dbyangs sgrog la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje lcags kyu mda' dang ral gri g.yas/ /zhags pa dang bcas sdigs mdzub dgra sta gzhu/ /rin chen 'bar ba g.yon pa'i phyag na bsnams/ /stag dang sbrul gyis brgyan la phyag 'tshal lo/

/nyi mar rol pas bgegs dang 'byung po mnan/ /ma mo bdun dang srin mo sha za mo/ /gnod sbyin mo rnams rab tu skrag mdzad ma/ /ta la'i shing drung bzhugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rlung dang bad kan 'khrugs pa'i nad sel zhing / /thog dang ser ba rlung sogs gnod pa 'joms/ /dus min 'chi ba nges par 'joms mdzad ma/ /'jigs byed khro mo'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tshor ba gnas gyur ser sna rnam dag pa/ /mnyam nyid ye shes rang bzhin lha mo'i sku/ /rgyal ba kun gyi yon tan rigs las byung / /rma bya chen mo'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gser zangs mdog mtshungs zhal gsum phyag brgyad ma/ /g.yas zhal mig sman ltar gnag g.yon pa dmar/ /pad ma zla bar sems dpa'i skyil krung bzhugs/ /sna tshogs rgyan gyis spras la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /mchog sbyin bum pa 'khor lo ral gri g.yas/ /dge slong dang bcas lhung bzed rma bya'i sgro/ /sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa'i bum pa dang / /rgyal mtshan g.yon pas bsnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bden pa grub pa'i drang srong rnams kyis mchod/ /srin mo'i tshogs 'joms klu rnams skrag mdzad cing / /lha ma yin rnams kun tu rmongs byed pa/ /mya ngan med pa'i shing drung bzhugs la 'dud/ /brtan dang g.yo ba'i dug rnams rab 'joms shing / /dmod pa'i mda' dang 'khrul 'khor 'jig par byed/ /sgrub po dri med bde la 'god mdzad pa/ /rig sngags rgyal mo'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'du shes gnas gyur 'dod chags rnam dag pa/ /kun rtog ye shes rang bzhin lha mo'i sku/ /rgyal ba kun gyi gsung gi rigs las byung / /gsang sngags rjes su 'dzin la phyag 'tshal lo/ /pad+ma rā ga'i mdangs ldan zhal gsum ma/ /g.yas gnag g.yon pa kun da zla ba'i mdog /spyan gsum pad+ma rgyas 'dra 'gro la gzigs/ /rin chen rgyan gyis mdzes la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcu gnyis phyag gi dang po chos 'chad tshul/ /gnyis pa mnyam bzhag mchog sbyin mi 'jigs sbyin/

/rdo rje mda' g.yas g.yon na sdigs mdzub zhags/ /bum pa snye ma gzhu yi brel la 'dud/ /'jig rten skyong ba rnams kyis zhabs mchod cing / /rgyal chen bzhi yis rtag par rim gro byed/ /rig pa 'dzin pa rnams kyis gus btud pa/ /shi ri sha yi shing drung bzhugs la 'dud/ /ye shes sgyu ma'i sprul par rnam rol zhing / /sngags kyi sbyor bas 'gro ba yongs su 'dzin/ /lha dang lha min klu dbang tshogs rnams kun/ /dbang du mdzad pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'du byed gnas gyur phrag dog rnam dag pa/ /bya grub ye shes rang bzhin lha mo'i sku/ /rgyal ba kun gyi phrin las rigs las byung / /bsil ba'i tshal gyi zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhal gsum phyag drug margad mdog mtshungs pa/ /g.yas dkar g.yon zhal kar+ṇi ka yi mdog /rin chen 'od 'phro du mas rnam par brgyan/ /sgeg pa'i tshul 'chang khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyag g.yas mi 'jigs sbyin dang rdo rje mda'/ /g.yon pa zhags pa dang bcas sdigs mdzub dang / /rin chen rgyal mtshan dang ni gnam ru 'dzin/ /dpal mo dgyes dgur spyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lha dang grub pa rig 'dzin gyis mchod cing / /smyo byed brjed byed la sogs 'byung po'i tshogs/ /kun tu skrag mdzad bya yi gdon rnams 'joms/ /tsam pa'i shing drung bzhugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhi dang rgyas dang dbang dang dgug pa dang / /bskrad dang dbye ba bsad pa la sogs pa/ /las rnams thams cad so sor stsol mdzad pa/ /don kun sgrub byed ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gzi brjid ldan zhing dpal dang ldan/ /sde chen stobs kyang chen po ste/ /kun nas rang phyogs legs skyong ba'i/ /phyogs skyong rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /glang chen sa srung bu la ni/ /rol pas bzhugs pa gser mdog can/ /rdo rje 'chang ba lha yi rje/ /brgya byin la yang phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnam par bsgyings pa'i ma he la/ /mnyam par gnas la in+d+ra'i mdog /be con 'chang ba ma mo'i rje/

/gshin rje la yang phyag 'tshal lo/ /chu srin la gnas chu shel mdog /nor bu dang bcas gdengs kas brgyan/ /sbrul zhags 'dzin pa klu yi rje/ /chu yi lha la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rta mchog bzhon pa gser mdog can/ /nor bus mtshan pa'i dbyug tho dang / /ne'u le 'dzin pa gnod sbyin rje/ /lus ngan po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /khyu mchog la gnas 'jigs chen po/ /phyugs bdag chen po kun+da'i mdog /rtse gsum 'chang ba 'byung po'i rje/ /dbang ldan ldan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ra skyes zhon cing chos dmar ba/ /mchog sbyin dbyug gu bgrang phreng dang / ghun+dhe 'dzin pa drang srong rje/ /me yi lha la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gad rgyang sgrogs pa'i ro langs la/ /brtan par gnas pa char sprin mdog /ral gri 'chang ba srin po'i rje/ /bden bral la yang༞ rnam par rtsen pa'i ri dwags kyi/ /zhon pa la gnas margad mdog /ba dan 'dzin pa rig 'dzin rje/ /rlung gi lha la༞ ngang pa'i rgyal po la gnas pa/ /gser mdog gdong bzhi pad+ma dang / /bgrang phreng ghun+dhe glegs bam dang / /skye dgu'i mes por༞ phag pa zhon cing brtan par gnas/ /shin tu 'bar ba'i gser mdog can/ /bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa 'dzin/ /skye dgu'i ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /li khri'i mdog mtshungs rab mdzes shing / /shing rta'i steng na nyi dkyil bzhugs/ /pad+ma dmar po'i sdong bu 'dzin/ /gzi brjid mtha' yas la phyag 'tshal/ /kun da ltar dkar zla ba ni/ /bsil zer byed pa'i dbus na bzhugs/ /ku mu ta yi sdong bu 'dzin/ /zhi mdzad de la༞ mig dmar pad+ma rā ga'i mdog /rā skyes zhon cing khro tshul can/ /gri gug dang ni mi mgo 'dzin/ /mthu chen de la༞ gza' lhag margad ltar ljang zhing / /pad+ma la gnas zhi ba'i sku/ /mdzes shing rab sgeg mda' gzhu 'dzin/ /bde mdzad de la༞ drang srong phur bu gser mdog can/ /glang chen steng na rol pas bzhugs/ /bgrang phreng ril ba spyi blugs 'dzin/ /thugs rje can la༞

pa sangs gangs ri'i mdog mtshungs pa/ /pad+ma la gnas bzhad pa'i zhal/ /shel phreng dang ni ril ba 'dzin/ /phan mdzad de la༞ spen pa smig sman ltar gnag cing / /lto 'phye la zhon 'jigs pa'i gzugs/ /phreng ba dang ni dbyug gu 'dzin/ /mthu chen de la༞ lha min dbang po sgra gcan ni/ /sku mdog dmar nag 'jigs chen po/ /phyag gnyis nyi ma zla ba 'dzin/ /stobs chen de la༞ tog ni brag ri'i steng na bzhugs/ /kha dog skya sangs drag po'i gzugs/ /ral gri dang ni sbrul zhags 'dzin/ /gtum chen de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sngon gyi legs spyad las grub pa'i/ /mthu dang rdzu 'phrul mtha' yas pa/ /rang rang phyogs dang dus skyong ba'i/ rgyu skar rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang dag shar gyi phyogs gnas pa'i/ /smin drug dang ni snar ma dang / /mgo lag nabs so rgyal skag la/ /mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ /lho yi phyogs na 'khod pa yi/ /mchu dang gre bo me bzhi yi/ /nag pa sa ri sa ga la/ /mchod cing bstod de༞ gang dag nub kyi phyogs gnas pa'i/ /lha mtshams snron snrubs chu stod dang / /chu smad byi bzhin gro zhun la/ /mchod cing bstod de༞ byang phyogs gnas pa'i mon gre dang / /mon gru khrums stod khrum smad dang / /nam gru tha skar bra nye la/ /mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ /rgyal po chen po dpal ldan pa/ /margad mdog mtshungs pi waṃ 'dzin/ /dri za rnams la dbang mdzad pa/ /yul 'khor srung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpa' bo chen po stobs po che/ kha dog sngon po ral gri 'dzin/ /grul bum rnams la dbang mdzad pa/ /'phags skyes po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mnga' bdag chen po mthu bo che/ /kha dog dmar ser sbrul zhags 'dzin/ /klu yi tshogs la dbang mdzad pa/ /mig mi bzang la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sde dpon chen po gser mdog can/ /be con dang ni ne'u le 'dzin/ /gnod sbyin tshogs la dbang bsgyur ba/ /rnam thos sras la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa'i bstod rgyas pa'am/

thugs skabs chung dus 'ga' rer ni/ /gtso mo lnga la rang bzhin dag pa sogs/ /gzi brjid ldan zhing man chad tshang ba'am/ /phyogs skyong gza' rgyu skar gsum la spyir sh+lau ka re re/ rgyal po bzhi la tshang ma mdzad kyin yang snang ngo / /de nas pad kor sngon 'gro'i gzungs thag blangs nas g.yas kyis bzung / g.yon phreng ba 'dren pas/ rang gi snying kha'i sa bon las sngags kyi 'od zer gzungs thag la brten nas song bas lha rnams kyi thugs rgyud bskul nas/ sku'i cha thams cad las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas bum pa gang bar bsam/ de'i rlangs pa 'od zer gyi tshul du 'phros pa steng gi me long gi sngags la phog pas sngags nus ldan du byin gyis brlabs/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas bum pa'i mdun du slob ma gos dkar po gyon/ thal mo sbyar nas 'khod pa'i lus la phog pas/ de'i nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad 'od zer gyis bsregs sbyangs bkrus dag par bsams nas gtso mo'i sngags brgya rtsa/ gzhan rnams la nyer gcig sogs bzlas/ dung chos kyi chu la/ oṃ badz+ra u da ka hūm̐/ bdun bzlas nas/ stong gsum 'di'am stong gsum gzhan dag na/ /lha rdzas mchod yon ji snyed mchis pa kun/ /bcom ldan bum pa'i lha la bdag 'bul na/ /thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pu dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ zhes dang dung chos kyi chu 'bul/ stong gsum༞ lha rdzas me tog༞ bcom ldan༞ thugs rjes༞ puṣ+pe༞ thog mtha' kun la 'gre/ mchod yon gnas su bdug spos/ ar+ghaṃ gnas su dhūpe bcug pas mchod/ bcom ldan 'das ma bum pa'i lha tshogs kyis bdag dang rdo rje'i slob ma rnams kyi sdig pa dang / sgrib pa/ byad byur/ skal ba ngan pa/ bkra mi shis pa sogs mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad byang zhing dag nas mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa bstsal du gsol/

oṃ badz+ra muḥ ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa zhu ba las bdud rtsi'i chur gyur/ gzhal yas khang zhu nas bum par gyur/ ces brjod/ de nas gtor ma rnams la chu gtsang mas chab bran/ yak+ṣas bsangs/ oṃ badz+ra sogs kyis sbyangs/ a kā ros byin gyis brlabs pa rnams 'og ma kun la'ang dmigs bsal can ma gtogs rigs 'gre bar byas la/ oṃ pañca de ba ma hā rak+ṣa se sa pa ri wā re na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yoḥbi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥsarba tha khaṃ ut+ga te s+pha ra ṇa e maṃ ga ga na khaṃ gṛh+ṇa daṃ ba liṃ ta swāhā/ rdo rje thal mo kha phye ba lan gsum gyis phul nas/ oṃ pañca de ba ma hā rak+ṣa si badz+ra puṣ+pe pra tīts+tsha āḥhūm̐ nyer spyod/ oṃ pañca de wa ma hā rak+ṣa si badz+ra dhū pe pra tīts+tsha āḥhūm̐/ rang bzhin dag pa sogs kyis bstod/ bcom ldan 'das ma srung ba lngas bdag dang rdo rje'i slob ma rnams kyi nad gdon bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi ba dang / /tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor rgyas pa'i phrin las mdzad du gsol/ gnyis pa rnam sras/ gsum pa mgon po/ bzhi pa bstan srung ma sogs sgos kyi chos skyong gang yin la rang rang gi gtor chog ltar phul/ lnga pa byin gyis brlabs/ phyogs skyong 'jig rten skyong ba dbang dang ldan/ /thugs rje thabs mkhas thugs dam dkyel po che/ /lha dang drang srong yi dwags srin po klu/ /rig 'dzin rgyal po dang ni gdon gyi bdag de dag so so'i dbang po'i skur ston cing / /phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten skyong ba bzhugs so 'tshal/ /bstan pa rgyas pa'i slad du spyan 'dren na/ /'gro ba'i don du mchod kyis gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ dā sha diklo ka pā la sa pā ri wā ra ar+ṣa ya dzaḥ ar+ghaṃ swā hāḥ pad+ma ka ma la ye satwaṃ/ oṃ dā sha diklo ka pā la sa pā ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pā t+yaṃ nas shap+ta pra tīts+tsha āḥhūm̐ sogs kyis mchod/ dbang po rdo rje 'chang ba'i lha/ /lha yi rgyal po gdon gyi bdag

/shar phyogs gdon gyi tshogs bcas la/ /mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ /me ste bsreg bya za ba'i lha/ /drang srong rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /shar lho me lha'i tshogs bcas la/ /mchod cing bstod de༞ gshin rje be con 'chang ba'i lha/ /ma mo'i rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /lho phyogs gshin rje'i tshogs bcas la/ /mchod cing༞ gdon dang bral ba legs ldan lha/ /srin po'i rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /lho nub srin po'i tshogs bcas la/ /mchod cing༞ zhags pa thogs pa chu yi lha/ /klu yi rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /nub phyogs chu lha 'khor bcas la/ /mchod cing༞ rlung ste srog kyang 'dzin pa'i lha/ /rig 'dzin rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /nub byang rlung lha'i tshogs bcas la/ /mchod cing bstod de༞ gnod sbyin lag na dbyug tho thogs/ /nor srung gdon gyi bdag po ste/ /byang phyogs gnod sbyin 'khor bcas la/ /mchod cing bstod de༞ dbang dang ldan pa 'dren pa'i lha/ /bgegs kyi rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /byang shar dbang ldan 'khor bcas la/ /mchod cing༞ /steng gi tshangs pa chen po dang / /nyi ma zla ba gza' chen po/ /gza' dang rgyu skar bcas pa la/ /mchod cing༞ 'og gi klu ste sa yi lha/ /sa 'dzin lag pa chen po dang / /dam tshig shes pa'i tshogs bcas la/ /mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ /oṃ in+d+ra ya swāhā/ oṃ ag+nā ya swāhā/ oṃ ya mā ya swāhā/ oṃ ni ri ta ye swāhā/ oṃ ba ru ṇa ya swāhā/ oṃ bā ya be swāhā/ oṃ ku be ra ya swāhā/ oṃ i shwa na ya swāhā/ oṃ bra h+ma ṇa ya swāhā/ oṃ sur+ya ya swāhā/ oṃ tsan+d+ra ya swa hā/ oṃ pṛ thi bi bye swāhā/ oṃ nā ge bh+yaḥswāhā/ oṃ a su re bh+yaḥswāhā/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta nas/ ga ga na khaṃ gṛh+ṇa daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi swāhā/ gsum/ dril bsil/ shar phyogs rdo rje can gyi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas/ /gtor ma 'bul ba 'di dag bzhes su gsol/

/me dang gshin rje bden bral srin po'i bdag /chu bdag rlung bdag nor gyi bdag po dang / /dbang ldan lha ste 'byung po'i bdag po dang / /steng gi nyi zla tshangs pa chen po dang / /lha rnams kun dang sa yi klu rnams dang / /ri yi lha dang gnod sbyin tshogs rnams la/ /swa swa so sor gtor ma 'bul ba rnams/ /rab tu dges pa yis ni bzhes nas kyang / /rang rang phyogs su legs par bzhugs nas su/ /rang gi bud med mdza' bshes gnyen 'dun dang / /nang mi dmag dang dpung bcas thabs cig tu/ /me tog dri dang byug pa gtor mar bcas/ /'di rnams btung zhing legs par gsol nas kyang / /bdag gi las 'di'i 'bras bu mchis par mdzod/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di snoms la nas/ /yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog gi bar/ oṃ dā sha diklo ka pa la sa pa ri wā ra gats+tsha/ gtor ma mdun bskyed kyi phyogs skyong la gtso bor 'bul zhing phrin las zhu ba'i gnad kyang shes par bya'o/ /skabs 'dir chu'i sbyin sreg byed par spro na 'og tu gsal lo/ /drug pa bsangs sbyangs byin brlabs/ oṃ dhṛṣ+ṭa raṣ+ṭa ye na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yoḥbatags pa gsum gyis phul/ oṃ dhṛṣ+ṭa raṣ+ṭa ye badz+ra puṣ+pe pra tits+tsha āḥhūm̐ sogs 'di bzhin du 'og ma'i nyer mchod thams cad la'ang so so'i mtshan sngags sbyar ro/ /nyer mchod kyis mchod/ rgyal po chen po dpal ldan pa sogs kyis bstod/ s+yād+ya the dan/ dha ra ṇi/ dhā ra ṇi/ pra dh+wan+sa ni/ bhan dza ni/ pra bhan+dza ni/ bi dha ma ṇi/ ki suṃ ru ṣe/ pa ka le/ sā ra the/ sā ra ba ti/ shu la dha ri/ shu la dha ri ṇi/ shud+dha tsa ra ṇi/ gho ṣa ba ti pā a gre shān+tiṃ che ge mo rdo rje slob ma rnams zhes 'og nas 'byung ba'i che ge mo rnams la'ang shes par bya'o/ /shar phyogs su bde legs su gyur cig swāhā/ tshangs pa dang ni brgya byin dang / /'jig rten skyong ba'i dbang phyug che/ /gnod sbyin sde dpon thams cad dang /

/'phrog ma bu dang bcas rnams kyis/ /bdag gi me tog spos rnams dang / /gtor ma 'di ni blang bar mdzod/ /de rnams kyis ni brtson 'grus dang / /gzi brjid dbang phyug stobs kyis kyang / /nad rnams thams cad 'joms gyur cig /che ge mo shar phyogs bde legs su gyur cig swāhā/ tshig 'dis kyang gsol ba gdab bo/ /s+yād+ya the dan/ a khe na khe/ bi na khe/ babhe ba rā ṇe/ tsa sa le/ ba khe/ ba kha ne/ ba khi ne/ a khi ne/ na khi ne/ ba hā le/ bha ge bha gan+dha le/ ba she ba sha bar ti ni swāhā/ rgyal po chen po yul 'khor srung gi ming dang / stobs dang / dbang phyug dang / byin gyis che ge mo gdon thams cad dang gnod pa thams cad las thar bar gyur cig swāhā/ bdun pa byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ bi ru ḍha kā ye na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yoḥ sogs btags pa sogs gsum nyer mchod/ dpa' bo chen po sogs bstod pa/ s+yād+ya the dan shān+tiṃ sā ra ba ti/ kān+ti/ ka ra ba ti/ kiṃ ka si/ ki riṣ+ṭi/ kiṃ ba ṭi/ dha ra ṇi/ bar+dha ni/ bhu ma dhā ri ṇi/ bi bhu mi dhā ri ṇi/ hi ma ba ti/ dz+yo tish+tsa ra ṇi/ mā la a gri che ge mo lho phyogs su bde legs su gyur cig swāhā/ tshangs pa dang ni sogs brjod la/ s+yād+ya the dan/ kha kha kha me/ kha la ne/ kha lo me/ kha ra le/ kha la me/ kha lā me/ kha ra li khe/ ka ra khe/ kha ḍi ne/ kha ra li/ ka ra khi/ kha ra mi le/ ka sha ne/ kha ra ṭe/ kā le/ kā mi ni/ bi dha li/ bi dhi ye/ sha ya ne/ sha ma ba te sha mi/ sha ma ni swāhā/ rgyal po chen po 'phags skyes po'i ming dang / stobs dang / dbang phyug dang / byin gyis che ge'i gdon dang / gnod pa thams cad zhi bar gyur cig swāhā/ de dag gi tshe sngags rnams kyi dus/ dril bu si li li rgyun chags/ tshangs pa sogs tshigs bcad la sum rdung / lhug pa rnams kyi tshe/ dril bu mi gsil gyur cig swā hā sogs/ mjug kun la bcad btub tu drag por dkrol ba phyag len to/

/gong 'og kun tu gces so/ /gtor ma brgyad pa byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ badz+ra bi ru pak+ṣa ya na ma sarba ta thā ga ta bh+yoḥsogs gsum/ nyer mchod/ mnga' bdag chen po sogs kyis bstod/ s+yad+yā the dan/ dhar mi ba ra a gre/ ba la ba ti/ ba li ni bi seṅge/ bi ba si/ sā ga re/ kha ri ka si le/ tsaṇ+ḍa li/ da ra ṇi/ ti ri ṇi/ tā ra ṇi/ bi rā dza ne/ bi dhā ri ṇi/ bar+ṇa ba ti/ a tsa li/ che ge mo nub phyogs su bde legs su gyur cig swāhā/ tshangs pa dang ni sogs dang / s+yād+ya the dan/ kra ga me/ kra ka ma ṇi/ kra ka she/ kra kra she/ kra ga sa she kru shru me/ kru shru me/ kru ke ke krug kha me/ kru ge a ga le/ na ga le/ sa ma ga le/ ka nu me/ hu me a lu ke ka la ma ke ka la le/ i re mi re dhi re/ a ru ga ba ti swāhā/ rgyal po chen po mig mi bzang gi ming dang / stobs dang / dbang phyug dang / byin gyis che ge mo bde legs su gyur cig swāhā/ gtor ma dgu pa byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ bai shra ba ṇa ya sarba ta thā ga ta bh+yoḥsogs gsum/ nyer mchod/ ded dpon chen po sogs kyis bstod/ s+yād+ya the dan/ khad ge khad+ga gar+dhe/ bi tsak+ṣa ṇe/ tsakre/ rā dza ne/ tsaṇ+ḍe tsa ba le/ bhī ma sar ba ti/ kha ra a gre ku ṭi/ la ka ra a gre/ akā k+ṣi/ brga ba ti/ sā rang ga ba ti/ mārga ba ti/ garga ba tra/ bi tra ba ti/ tsi tra kan+te/ che ge mo byang phyogs su bde legs su gyur cig swāhā/ tshangs pa dang ni sogs/ s+yād+ya the dan/ sid+dhe su sid+dhe/ satwo a ro/ a ra ṇe/ ba le me hā ba le/ dzam+bhe/ stam+bhe/ dza ṭi le/ a kha ne/ ma kha ne/ kha kha ne/ kha ra ṭ+ṭe/ kha rarge/ ha ri si/ ka le/ ti miṃ gi le/ ti miṅge le/ ti miṃ gā li ni/ maṅga le swāhā/ rgyal po chen po rnam thos kyi bu'i ming dang / stobs dang / dbang phyug dang / byin gyis che ge mo dge bar gyur cig swāhā/ bcu pa/ bcu gcig pa gnyis byin gyis brlabs/ brah+ma pṛ thi wi na maḥsogs btags pa gsum/

nyer mchod/ ngang pa'i rgyal po sogs dang / phag la zhon cing sogs kyis bstod/ s+yād+ya the dan/ bra h+me bra h+ma/ gho ṣe bra h+ma/ sā re badz+re badz+ra gho ṣe/ badz+ra dha re/ s+d+yi re pā re/ a tsa le/ a ra ṇe/ ī ṣa ṇe/ a ra ṇe/ ṭe ra ṇe/ shū re pa ri a gra prāste/ sā ra ba te/ che ge mo phyogs mtshams thams cad dang / steng dang / 'og rnams su bde legs su gyur cig swāhā/ tshangs pa dang ni sogs/ s+yād+ya the dan/ a paṃ ge kharga ba te/ ba la ba te/ ba la nir+gho ṣe/ shū re shū ra dha re/ badz+ra ga me me badz+ra dha re/ stam+bhe/ dzam+bhe/ dri dha swa re/ bi ra dze/ mi gha se/ ba rā gra/ prā ba te/ a ra ṇi/ dhar+m+ma yuk+te/ de shi bi ghuṣ+ṭe swāhā/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan dang / stobs dang / dbang phyug dang / byin gyis che ge mo bde legs su gyur cig swāhā/ bcu gnyis pa dang bcu gsum pa byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ ma hā gra he sarba na k+ṣa tre bh+yaḥn maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yo sogs gsum nyer mchod/ nyi ma zla ba mig dmar dang / /lhag pa phur bu pa sangs dang / /spen pa sgra gcan ke tu ste/ /gza' rnams la yang phyag 'tshal lo/ /sngon gyi legs spyad sogs kyis bstod nas/ gza' gang dag rgyu skar rnams kyi khrod na rgyu zhing / 'grib pa dang / 'phel ba dang / bde ba dang / sdug bsngal ba dang / lo legs pa dang / lo nyes pa dag kyang ston pa rnams 'di lta ste/ gza' nyi ma dang / zla ba dang / phur bu dang / pa sangs dang / spen pa dang / mig dmar dang / lhag pa dang / gza' lha min dbang po sgra gcan dang / gza' du ba mjug ring ngo / /rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad ni/ de ltar phyogs na bdun bdun no/ /skar ma gza' bdun de bzhin te/ /rdzu 'phrul che zhing dka' thub che/ nyi ma dang ni zla ba dang / /sum cu rtsa bdun tshang ba dag /'char ba dang ni nub pa dang / /mtshon cha'i 'khor lo bzhin du rgyu/ /'jig rten du ni zad 'phel byed/ /gzi che rdzu 'phrul chen po dag

/rab tu dang ba'i sems kyis su/ /rig sngags rjes su yi rangs byos/ /de dag gis kyang / ming 'di zhes bya ba la/ rdo rje slob ma rnams la zhes 'og ma rnams la'ang shes par bya'o/ /bsrung bar gyis shig lo brgya 'tsho bar gyur cig ston brgya mthong bar shog cig rgyu skar gang dag nam mkha' la rgyu zhing snang bar byed pa rnams 'di lta ste/ smin drug dang ni snar ma dang / mgo dang lag dang nabs so dang / /rgyal ni bkra shis phun sum tshogs/ /de bzhin skag ste bdun pa yin/ /de ltar rgyu skar bdun po de dag ni shar gyi phyogs na gnas pa dag ste gang dag shar phyogs skyong zhing srung bar byed pa dag go /de dag gis kyang ming 'di zhes bya ba la bsrung bar gyis shig /lo brgya 'tsho bar gyur cig /ston brgya mthong bar shog cig /mchu ni mi zad 'joms pa dang / /de bzhin gre dang dbo dang ni/ /me bzhi nag pa sa ri dang / /sa ga de ltar bdun po ni/ /lho yi phyogs na gnas pa dag ste/ gang dag lho phyogs skyong zhing srung bar byed pa dag go /de dag gis kyang ming 'di zhes bya ba la bsrung bar gyis shig lo brgya 'tsho bar gyur cig ston brgya mthong bar gyur cig lha mtshams gzi brjid chen mo dang / de bzhin snron dang snrubs dang ni/ /chu stod dang ni chu smad dang / /byi bzhin dang ni gro zhun dang / /de ltar rgyu skar bdun po ni/ /gang dag nub phyogs skyong zhing srung bar byed pa dag go /de dag gis kyang ming 'di zhes bya ba la bsrung bar gyis shig lo brgya 'tsho bar gyur cig ston brgya mthong bar shog cig mon gru dang ni mon gre dang / /khrums stod dang ni khrums smad dang / /nam gru tha skar bra nye ste/ /de ltar rgyu skar bdun po ni/ /byang gi phyogs na gnas pa dag ste/ /gang dag byang phyogs skyong zhing srung bar byed pa dag go /de dag gis kyang ming 'di zhes bgyi ba bsrung bar gyis shig

lo brgya 'tsho bar gyur cig ston brgya mthong bar shog cig rdo rje'i slob ma rnams la gza' dang rgyu skar thams cad dge bar gyur cig swāhā/ bcu bzhi pa bsangs sbyangs sogs/ oṃ maṅga la sarba dz+nyā su ṇa shrī nan ti e h+ya hi pad+ma ka la ya satwaṃ/ oṃ maṃ ga la nas nan ti'i rjes su/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga tas phul te/ nyer mchod/ rgyal po chen po bzhi'i lam dang lam ma yin pa na gnas pa bzhi yod de/ de dag kyang gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ bkra shis ldan dang / kun shes dang / gang po dang / dga' ba'i dpal rnams te/ gang de dag gi ming shes pa dang / rus shes pa de la ni/ rgyal po'i 'jigs pa mi 'byung ngo / /chom rkun gyi༞ me'i༞ chu'i༞ mi'i༞ mi ma yin pa'i 'jigs pa mi 'byung ngo / /de bas na ming 'di zhes bya ba'i phyir/ bkra shis ldan dang / kun shes dang / gang po dang / dga' ba'i dpal la gsol lo/ /gsol ba 'debs so/ /rdo rje slob ma rnams kyis zhes sogs la rnam pa gtad shes par bya'o/ /'das pa dang / ma 'ongs pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi bkas/ ming 'di zhes bya ba la bsrung ba dang / yongs su bskyab pa dang / yongs su gzung ba dang / zhi ba dang / bde legs su 'gyur ba dang / chad pa bzlog par gyis shig tad+ya thā/ bi mu de/ bī tī de/ pi tsa ri dai/ pi ga ri de ko ḍi/ kā ra bī ra swā ri/ ma dhu ra/ ghoṣ+ṭe/ sha ta ha ni ta/ bha shi ta ghe/ ag ke nāg ke bi ka ḍi tī/ bi ku ḍi ti/ bi ra dzi/ bi gaṣ+ṭa be de/ bde legs su gyur cig swāhā/ gats+tsha thal mo gnyis phyag sbyar la so so'i mtheb srin gyis se gol gtogs/ zhes gshegs su gsol/ bco lnga pa byin rlabs/ oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi dze ta bha dra ka ra shi na gra e h+ya hi pad+ma ka ma la ya satwaṃ/ oṃ badz+ra nas shi na gra'i rjes su na maḥsarba ta thā ga tas phul la/ nyer mchod/ lag na rdo rje'i phu bo lag myur zhes bya ba grong khyer khor yug na gnas pa yod de/

gang de'i ming shes pa dang / rus shes pa de la ni/ rgyal po'i 'jigs pa mi 'byung ngo / /chom rkun gyi༞ me'i༞ chu'i༞ mi'i༞ mi ma yin pa'i 'jigs pa mi 'byung ngo / /de bas na ming 'di zhes bya ba'i phyir/ lag na rdo rje'i phu bo lag myur la gsol lo/ /gsol ba 'debs so/ /'das pa dang / ma 'ongs pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi bkas/ ming 'di zhes bya ba la bsrung ba dang / yongs su bskyab pa dang / yongs su gzung ba dang / zhi ba dang / bde legs su 'gyur ba dang / chad pa bzlog par gyis shig tad+ya thā sogs/ sngags gong bzhin dang / gats+tsha/ bcu drug pa byin rlabs/ oṃ tsa tur da sha ma hā rak+ṣa si/ e h+ya hi/ sngags de nyid la/ na maḥsarba sogs sbyar ba gsum gyis phul/ nyer mchod dang / srin mo chen mo bcu bzhi yod de/ de dag gis ni byang chub sems dpa' yum gyi lhums su zhugs pa na yang bsrung bsrung ba ste/ sku 'khrungs pa na yang bsrung bsrung ngo / bcu bzhi gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ stobs ldan/ dri ma med dang / sgra chen dang / rab mnyen dang / 'jigs byed ma dang / dzam+bu mgrin dang / mchog len dang / bla ma dang / grags ldan ma dang / 'thab dga' ma dang / smad grags ma dang / rtse mo dga' dang / sa 'dzin dang / 'thab 'jug go /gang de dag gi ming shes pa dang / rus shes pa de la rgyal po'i 'jigs pa mi 'byung ngo / /chom rkun gyi༞ me'i༞ chu'i༞ mi'i༞ mi ma yin pa'i 'jigs pa mi 'byung ngo / /de bas na/ ming 'di zhes bya ba'i phyir/ stobs ldan dang / dri ma med pa dang / sgra chen dang / rab mnyen dang / 'jigs byed ma dang / 'dzam bu mgrin dang / mchog len dang / bla ma dang / grags ma dang / 'thab dga' ma dang / smad grags ma dang / rtsed mo dga' dga' dang / sa 'dzin dang / 'thab 'jug ste/ de rnams la gsol lo/ /gsol ba 'debs so/ /'das pa dang / ma 'ongs pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi bkas/

ming 'di zhes bya ba la bsrung ba dang / yongs su bskyab pa dang / yongs su gzung ba dang / zhi ba dang / bde legs su 'gyur ba dang / chad pa bzlog par gyis shig tad+ya thā/ sogs sngags gong bzhin dang gats+tsha/ bcu bdun pa byin gyis brlabs/ aṣ+ṭa ma hā rak+ṣa si e h+ya hi/ sngags de la na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta sogs btags pa gsum gyis phul/ nyer mchod kyis mchod/ srin mo brgyad yod de/ de dag ni/ skyes pa dang bud med gnyid log kyang rung / ma log kyang rung ste/ gzi brjid 'phrog par byed do/ /de dag kyang gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ rwa dang / thub med dang / ngan slob dang / phra ma can dang / bran mo dmar mo dang / rab chen dang / mig bzang dang / brgyad pa ste/ 'jigs byed do/ /gang de dag gis ming shes pa dang / rus shes pa de la ni/ de dag gis srung ba byed cing / rgyal po'i 'jigs pa mi 'byung ngo / /chom rkun gyi༞ me'i༞ chu'i༞ mi'i༞ mi ma yin pa'i 'jigs pa mi 'byung ngo / /de bas na ming 'di zhes bya ba'i phyir/ rwa dang / thub med dang / ngan slob dang / phra ma can dang / bran mo dmar mo dang / rab chen dang / mig bzang dang / brgyad pa ste/ 'jigs byed do/ /de rnams la gsol lo/ /gsol ba 'debs so/ /'das pa dang / ma 'ongs pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi bkas/ ming 'di zhes bya ba la bsrung ba dang / yongs su bskyab pa dang / yongs su gzung ba dang / zhi ba dang / bde legs su 'gyur ba dang / chad pa bzlog par gyis shig tad+ya thā/ sogs sngags gong bzhin gats+tsha/ bco brgyad pa byin gyis brlabs/ sap+ta ma hā rak+ṣa si/ e h+ya hi/ sngags de la na maḥsarba sogs btags pa gsum gyis phul/ nyer mchod kyis mchod/ srin mo bdun yod de/ de dag gis khrag gi dri mnam na/ dpag tshad brgyar yang rgyug go /de dag kyang 'di lta ste/ gzi brjid mchog dang / dga' brtsegs dang / sna tshogs sbyin spong dang / bran mo dkar mo bzang dang /

'jug 'dod dang / grong khyer khor yug dang / bdun pa ste re srung ngo / /gang de dag gi ming shes pa dang / rus shes pa de la ni/ rgyal po'i 'jigs pa mi 'byung ngo / /chom rkun gyi༞ me'i༞ chu'i༞ mi'i༞ mi ma yin pa'i 'jigs pa mi 'byung ngo / /de bas na ming 'di zhes bya ba'i phyir/ gzi brjid mchog dang / dga' brtsegs dang / sna tshogs sbyin spong dang / bran mo dkar mo bzang dang / 'jug 'dod dang / grong khyer khor yug dang / bdun pa ste re srung rnams la gsol lo/ /gsol ba 'debs so/ /'das pa dang / ma 'ongs pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi bkas/ ming 'di zhes bya ba la bsrung ba dang / yongs su bskyab pa dang / yongs su gzung ba dang / zhi ba dang / bde legs su 'gyur ba dang / chad pa bzlog par gyis shig tad+ya thā sogs sngags gong bzhin gats+tsha/ bcu dgu pa byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ kā li ma hā rak+ṣa si/ e h+ya hi/ sngags de la na maḥsarba sogs btags pa gsum gyis phul/ nyer mchod kyis mchod/ srin mo nag mo zhes bya ba bu stong yod pa/ rgya mtsho'i 'gram na gnas pa/ mtshan gcig la dpag tshad brgyad khrir phyin pa gcig yod de/ gang de'i ming shes pa dang / rus shes pa de la/ rgyal po'i 'jigs pa mi 'byung ngo / /chom rkun gyi༞ me'i༞ chu'i༞ mi'i༞ mi ma yin pa'i 'jigs pa mi 'byung ngo / /de bas na ming 'di zhes bya ba'i phyir/ srin mo chen mo nag mo la gsol lo/ /gsol ba 'debs so/ /'das pa dang / ma 'ongs pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi bkas/ ming 'di zhes bya ba la bsrung ba dang / yongs su bskyab pa dang yongs su gzung ba dang / zhi ba dang / bde legs su 'gyur ba dang / chad pa bzlog par gyis shig tad+ya thā sogs gong bzhin/ gats+tsha/ nyi shu pa byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ pañca ma hā rak+ṣa si/ e h+ya hi/ nyer mchod kyis mchod/ srin mo chen mo lnga yod de/

gnod sbyin 'bum phrag bdun cu rtsa bdun dang lhan cig tu 'dzam bu'i gling gi mi rnams bsrung zhing skyob par byed do/ /de dag kyang gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ rtag tu myos dang / rjes su myos dang / stobs kyis rgyags dang / 'od ma'i sbubs dang / lnga pa ste 'byor ldan no/ /gang de dag gi ming shes pa dang / rus shes pa de la ni rgyal po'i 'jigs pa mi 'byung ngo / /chom rkun gyi༞ me'i༞ chu'i༞ mi'i༞ mi ma yin pa'i 'jigs pa mi 'byung ngo / /de bas na/ ming 'di zhes bya ba'i phyir/ rtag tu myos dang / rjes su myos dang / stobs kyis rgyags dang / 'od ma'i sbubs dang / lnga pa ste/ 'byor ldan rnams la gsol lo/ /gsol ba 'debs so/ /'das pa dang / ma 'ongs pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi bkas/ ming 'di zhes bya ba la bsrung ba dang / yongs su bskyab pa dang / yongs su gzung ba dang / zhi ba dang / bde legs su 'gyur ba dang / chad pa bzlog par gyis shig tad+ya thā/ bi mu de/ bī tī de/ pi tsa ri rai/ pi ga ri de/ ka ra ḍi/ kā ra bī ra swā ri/ ma rtu ra/ ghoṣ+ṭe/ sha ta ha ni ta/ bha shi ta ghe/ ak+ko nāk+ko/ bi ka ḍī te/ bi ra dze bi gaṣ+ṭa be de/ bde legs su gyur cig swāhā/ nyer gcig pa ni/ bsangs sbyangs byin rlabs 'dra la/ 'dod pa'i rgyal po'i phyag rgya dang / hūm̐ mdzad las mdzub mo gnyis 'dud pa'o/ /oṃ ba ta li ba ta li/ ma hā ba ta li hūm̐ hūm̐ dzaḥdzaḥswāhā/ dril gsil dang / oṃ klu rgyal mtha' yas nor rgyas bu/ /g.yas rdo rje dang spyan 'dren pa'i tshul bya/ 'jog po dang ni stobs kyi rgyu/ /pad+ma pad+ma chen po dang / /dung skyong dang ni rigs ldan dang / /lha mo lha mo chen mo dang / /zla ba'i spyi gtsug spyi gtsug che/ /dbyug 'dzin dbyug 'dzin chen po dang / /sog ma med dang hu lun ta/ /dga' bo dang ni nyer dga' bo/ /rgya mtsho rgya mtsho chen po dang /

/tsha ba tsha ba chen po dang / /dpal gyi 'od dang 'od po che/ /rin chen 'od dang gzugs mdzes dang / /gzugs mdzes chen po sbrul bzang dang / /lto 'phye che dang tshi li dang / /tshi li chen po rnam dag ni/ /mchod pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ āḥgats+tsha/ āḥgats+tsha/ ma hā na ga a dhi pa ta ye sa pa ri wā ra sarba bhur bhu wa phruṃ phruṃ swāhā/ pad+ma ka ma la ya satwaṃ/ ma hā na ga a dhi pa te ye gṛh+na dam ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod nas shap+ta pra tits+tsha āḥhūm̐ gi bar/ g.yon khu tshur snying kha'i thad du bzhag pa'i mthe'u chung brkyang mthe bong gi steng du/ g.yas pa'i thal mo kha sbub la/ sor mo lnga sbrul mgo ltar byas pa'i klu dga' bar byed pa'i phyag rgya dang / oṃ hi li hi li ma hā hi li phruṃ phruṃ phraṃ swāhā/ zhes se gol dang bcas pa gsum dang / oṃ bhak+ṣa bhak+ṣa ya sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha dzuṃ phruṃ phu swāhā/ zhes pas phul/ ye dharma dang / sdig pa ci yang mi bya ste nas/ 'on kyang skyob pa'i sras su skye'i bar/ klu chen po brgyad kyis gtso byas pa'i klu'i rigs thams cad dang / bye brag tu bdag cag 'khor bcas la gnod cing lan chags pa'i klu dang sa bdag gi rigs thams cad tshim zhing dgyes par gyur cig gnod 'tshe'i bsam pa zhi nas phan pa byang chub kyi sems dang ldan par gyur cig oṃ ma hā na ga a dhi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra gats+tsha/ bya khyung gi phyag rgya kha phyir bltas dang / oṃ ga ru ḍa haṃ pa ne tsa le tsa le swā hās nag po'i klu rnams sprad do/ /nyer gnyis pa byin gyis brlabs la/ tshig rkang thog mtha' gnyis la dril gsil/ lha dang lha min gnod sbyin lto 'phye grul/ /nam mkha' lding dang 'dab bzang lus srul po/ /dri za srin po gdon gyi rigs rnams dang / /gang dag sa la gnas pa'i rdzu 'phrul can/ /bud med tshogs bcas g.yog 'khor bcas rnams la/ /bdag gis pus mo sa la btsugs nas su/ /thal mo sbyar te khyod la gsol 'debs kyi/

/gsan nas phan gdags phyir ni 'dir byon cig /oṃ de wa/ nā ga yak+ṣa/ gan+dha ba/ a su ra/ ga ru ḍa/ kīn+na ra/ ma ho ra ga ma nu ṣ+ya/ a ma nu ṣ+ya/ sa pa ri wā ra ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ ar+ghaṃ swāhā/ pad+ma ka ma la ya satwaṃ/ oṃ de ba nas/ a ma nu ṣ+ya sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta pra tīts+tsha āḥhūm̐ gi bar sogs kyis mchod/ oṃ de ba nā ga nas/ a ma nu ṣ+ya sa pa ri wā ra na maḥsarba ta thā ga te nas/ khā hi khā hi swā hā gsum/ 'byung po gang dag ri rab steng gnas dang / /dga' ba'i tshal dang lha yi gnas rnams dang / /shar nub ri dang nyi zla'i khyim rnams dang / /ri bo kun la gang dag gnas pa dang / /chu bo kun dang chu bo'i gnas rnams dang / /rin chen gnas na lhag par gang gnas dang / /mtsho dang rdzing bu steng ka chu ngogs dang / /g.ya' chu sil ma can na gang gnas dang / /grong dang phyug lhas grong khyer stong pa dang / khang stong dag dang lha yi khang pa dang / /gtsug lag khang ngam grong khyer gnas dag gam/ /dka' thub gnas dang glang chen dred dang ni/ /rgyal po'i dkor khang dag na gang gnas dang / /lam srang bzhi mdo dag dang sum mdo dang / /gang dag lam po che dang shing gcig drung / /dur khrod chen po nags tshal chen po dang / /seng ge dred dang gcan gzan gnas dag dang / /'brog chen 'jigs su rung bar gang gnas dang / /gang dag gling mchog dag na gnas pa dang / /lhun po dur khrod dag na gnas pa rnams/ /rab tu dgyes te mgu bar gyur nas su/ /me tog phreng dang dri dang bdug pa dang / /bstod dang gtor ma mar me gus 'bul na/ /'di rnams bzhes te btung zhing bsnams nas su/ /las 'di rnams kyi 'bras bu mchis par mdzod/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di snoms la/ /nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog gi bar/ de ltar du gyur pa'i mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di 'byung po sde brgyad 'khor dang bcas pa la bsngo ba yin pas/ rdo rje'i slob ma 'di rnams kyi sngon gyi las las gyur pa dang /

'phral gyi rkyen las gyur pa'i nad dang gnod pa rkyen dang bar du gcod pa thams cad zhi ba'i phrin las mdzod/ sarba lo kā ka ra sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ swā hā gats+tsha/ nyer gsum pa bsangs sbyangs sogs/ yul grong gnas gzhi'i bdag po sa pa ri wā ra a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ pad+ma ka ma la ya staṃ/ oṃ yul bdag grong bdag gnas bdag gzhi bdag gnyug mar gnas pa sa pa ri wā ra na maḥsarba sogs gsum/ nyer mchod/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe pra tīts+tsha āḥhūm̐ nas nai wid+ya pra tīts+tsha āḥhūm̐ gi bar dang / chos rnams thams cad rgyu las byung sogs nas/ sras su skye'i bar de ltar gyur pa'i chos dang zang zing gi sbyin pa rgya chen po 'di yul phyogs 'di nyid na gnas pa'i gnas po chen po gzhi'i bdag po 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad la bsngo ba yin pas yul phyogs 'di nyid du lo phyugs rtag tu legs pa/ char chu dus su 'bab pa/ mi nad dang / phyugs nad dang / mu ge dang / dus kyi 'khrug pa thams cad nye bar zhi ba dang / 'jig rten du dge legs rgya chen po rgyun mi chad par 'byung ba'i phrin las mdzod/ khyad par du yang rnal 'byor pa bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad la/ bsdad na bskul ma dang / 'gro na bshol 'debs ma mdzad par/ gnas mgron gyi dam tshig srungs/ gnod pa dang gdug pa'i bsam pa ngan pa dang / sbyor ba rtsub pa thams cad spongs/ zhi ba byang chub kyi sems dang ldan pa'i sgo nas/ gzhi bzang po chos ldan du skyong ba'i gnas po chen po mdzad du gsol/ ar+ghaṃ swāhā/ sarba swas+d+ya naṃ gats+tsha/ de nas bgegs gtor chang ngam chus sbyangs/ byin gyis brlabs/ na mo drin can rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi༞ chos kyi༞ dge 'dun gyi༞ bcom ldan 'das ma srung ba lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi༞ bden pa chen po'i byin gyis brlabs kyis rdo rje'i slob ma 'di rnams kyi lus ngag yid gsum la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i 'byung po gdon bgegs kyi rigs gang yin pa de dag thams cad/
