sa 'og sa steng sa bla gang na gnas kyang rung ste skad cig thang gcig yud tsam la gtor ma 'di len pa'i slad du 'dir mchis par gyur cig ṭak+ki hūm̐ dzaḥ gnyis/ oṃ gung ka ri gung ka ri swāhā/ oṃ pi tsi pi tsi swāhā/ oṃ gung gung swāhā/ gṛh+na dam ar+ghaṃ swāhā/ pad+ma ka ma la ya stāṃ/ oṃ gung ka ri gung ka ri swāhā/ oṃ pi tsi pi tsi swāhā/ oṃ gung gung swāhā/ sogs kyis mchod/ oṃ gung ka ri gung ka ri swāhā/ oṃ pi tsi pi tsi swāhā/ oṃ gung gung swāhā/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta nas/ khā hi khā hi swāhā/ gsum/ gang zhig mtshan mor rgyu ba yi/ /'byung po rnams dang sha za dang / /srin po sha rjen za ba dang / /sems can rnams pa sna tshogs pa/ /ljon shing gel pa sogs gnas pa/ /de dang de la gtor ma ni/ /bza' ba sha chang la phug bcas/ /'bras chen 'bras bu mang po yi/ /mchod pa 'di yis mgu byos la/ /gnod pa'i bsam pa zhi ba dang / /bdag cag rnams la phan pa'i sems/ /de ring phyin chad bskyed par gyis/ /rgyan gyis brgyan par byas kyang chos spyod cing / dul zhing yang dag sdom la tshangs par spyod/ /'byung po kun la chad pa spangs pa ste/ dge slong dge sbyong de yin bram ze de/ /mtshon chas mi 'jigs gang yang med/ /'chi ba'i srog la kun kyang 'dzems/ /'tsho ba'i zas la kun kyang 'du/ /rang gi lus la dpe long la/ /gzhan la gnod pa ma byed cig /oṃ chen po'am chung ngu gang dag gi /lus la mngon par gnod gyur pa/ nad de nye bar phyungs nas su/ /gdon de rang gi gnas su dengs/ /de ltar bdag gis ci nus kyis/ /mchod dang bsnyen bkur byas pa yis/ /dam tshig la ni gnas nas su/ /bdag gi bsam pa bskang bar mdzod/ /rtag tu dam tshig la gnas shing / /'dir ni bdag cag 'khor bcas kyi/ /nad de rab tu sol mdzod la/ /gdon khyod rang gi gnas su dengs/ /sarba bigh+nān gats+tsha zhes gtor ma dor rol mo drag po dang /

khro bo'i sngags bzlas so/ /de yang grwa lnga shes su gtor mas ma bcug ces/ sngar nas dkar mor byed pa 'dug pas/ nan tan gyis dogs gcod zhus pa'i gsung bzhin zhib par bkod pa'o/ /gzhan yang 'di'i gtor ma rnams dpe thog nas bsngo ba'i phyag len sngon gyi bla ma kha cig kyang mdzad pa yin par snang bas/ de bzhin yang shin tu rung bas ma chad pa gal che'o/ /gsung ngo / /de nas pañca rak+ṣa sngon 'gro'i nyer mchod rang bzhin dag pa sogs sh+lau ka lnga/ gzi brjid ldan zhing sogs sh+lau ka gcig nyi ma zla ba sogs sh+lau ka gcig sngon gyi legs spyad sogs sh+lau ka gcig rgyal ba'i bstan pa legs srung ba'i/ /yul 'khor srung dang 'phags skyes po/ /mig mi bzang dang rnam thos sras/ /'khor dang bcas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes bstod/ de nas bdag 'jug rgyas par ni/ phyag len la/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs sh+lau ka gcig gis dkyil 'khor la ku shas khrus bya/ ma ṇi dha ri'i rjes su bdag gi sdig sgrib thams cad sogs nas/ log par 'dren pa thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru ye swā hās rang nyid khrus byed/ ku shas byab cing / bdag la a pa na ye sbyar/ de nas maṇ+ḍal phul/ oṃ mu ne sogs kyis gsol ba gdab/ lha thams cad kyi sngags la a bhi ṣiñca btang ba'i chu dbang blang / spyi bor rdo rje rgya gram du bzhag nas/ gtso mo'i sngags dang rak+ṣas bsrung / rgyal ba sras bcas sogs brjod/ sems can gang dag man gyis bkra shis bya/ gtso mos ji ltar bka' bstsal pa sogs dang / bka' drin gyi maṇ+ḍal phul deng nas brtsams te sogs brjod do/ /bsdus pa ni/ mchod bstod kyi rjes su maṇ+ḍal/ gsol gdab/ bar thams cad kyis chu dbang blangs pas 'grub par 'gyur bas skabs su gang mkho sbyar te/ de nas/ don du gnyer ba'i slob ma rnams khrus bya/ yon dbul nas/ gral la tsog pur gnas su bcug la/ slob dpon gyis rdor dril 'dzin bzhin pas/ ma ṇi dha ri bzlas shing slob ma rnams la me tog gtor/

bum chu gtor nas bsangs nas/ tshon skud sna lnga nyis khug can de'i khug pa ske la bskon la mdud/ slob ma mang po yod na grogs dang bcas pa'i g.yas g.yon gnyis ka ru lag pa'i mthe bong dang gung mdzub la bskor ba'i mig la 'gugs pa ston pa'i khug mdud dper na ju thig gi mdud pa lta bu mig mang khrol le ba phyogs rer gnyis gnyis byas la/ lag pa'i srin mdzub gnyis dang / rkang pa'i mthe bong gnyis la bskon/ nad pa lta bu 'dug tshugs mi thub pa dang / tshon skud kyis ma 'byor na srin mdzub gnyis sam/ g.yon pa kho na la byas pas khyab par bshad do/ /de nas/ slob dpon gyis 'di skad du/ khyed rang rnams pa dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod cig slob dpon 'dod rgyal gyi phyag rgya byas/ rje btsun ma so sor 'brang mar gsal ba de'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas de'i sna la khro bo 'dod pa'i rgyal po mdog dmar po/ phyag na lcags kyu dang zhags pa bsnams pa/ dpag tu med pa spros te/ khyod rang rnams kyi lus ngag yid gsum la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i nad gdon bgegs dang bar du gcod pa thams cad kyi snying ka nas lcags kyus bkug mgrin pa nas zhags pas bcings te/ phyogs mtha' dag nas bkug nas khyod rang rnams kyi lus la bcings pa'i tshon skud sna lnga de nyid la thib thib thim pa'i mos pa mdzod/ yang ye shes kyi khro bo'i lha tshogs de dag khyod rang rnams kyi lus kyi nang na mar la song ste lus kyi nang na gnas pa'i nad rims gdon bgegs sdig sgrib nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad kyang rang dbang med par lus kyi kha dang mig la sogs pa nas phyi rol la 'thon te/ lus la bcings pa'i tshon skud sna lnga de nyid la thim pa'i mos pa mdzod cig na mo rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi༞ chos kyi༞ dge 'dun gyi༞

de bzhin gshegs pa dang / rdo rje༞ rin po che༞ pad+ma༞ las kyi rigs su zhugs pa thams cad༞ snying po༞ phyag rgya༞ gsang sngags༞ rig sngags/ gzungs sngags kyi lha'i khyad par thams cad kyi bka' bden pa dang / bcom ldan 'das ma srung ba lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi༞ dam pa'i chos skyong ba'i srung ma rnams kyi༞ bden par smra ba rnams kyi༞ drang srong rnams kyi༞ bden pa yang dag pa dang / bden pa chen po'i mthu dang / bden pa chen po'i mthu'i byin gyis brlabs kyis rdo rje'i slob ma 'di rnams kyi lus ngag yid gsum la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i sdig pa/ sgrib pa/ nad/ rims/ gdon/ bgegs/ byad kha/ mthu kha/ rbod gtong ngan pa/ chag sgo ngan pa/ rmi lam ngan pa/ mtshan ma ngan pa/ ltas ngan pa/ bkra mi shis pa/ mtshan mo nag mo'i gdon/ dus kyi zhags pa/ gshin rje'i pho nya/ bgegs dang log par 'dren pa la sogs pa/ mdor na mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad rang rang so so'i mgul la bcings pa'i tshon skud sna lnga 'di nyid la thim par gyur cig ṭak+ki hūm̐ dzaḥ ṭak+ki hūm̐ dzaḥ zhes pas khyod rang rnams kyi mgul la bcings pa'i tshon skud sna lnga de nyid/ nad gdon mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad 'dus pa'i phung po zhags pa nag po re rer gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de nyid slob dpon so sor 'brang mar gsal ba des/ khaṃ las skyes pa'i ye shes kyi ral gri so mar me dang chur bcug ste ngar btags pa de nyid kyis dum bur bcad pa'i mos par mdzod cigaces dang / ma ṇi dha ri sogs gtso mo lnga'i sngags brjod cing / ral gri so ma de mar me'i dbal dang / ting phor gyi chu la bcug ste ngar blud nas/ stong chen las gang dag sangs rgyas rang sangs rgyas/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi nyan thos dang / /tshangs pa dang ni lo ka skyong / /gnod sbyin sde dpon dbang phyug dang / /de bzhin gnod sbyin stobs chen dang / /'phrog ma bu dang bcas pa dang / /de dag mthu dang gzi brjid kyis/

/che ge mo'i byad rdo rje'i slob ma 'di rnams kyi stems las rnams chad gyur cig /sarba bhan+dha ka kodha tshe da na ye swāhā/ g.yon dril bu dang bcas pas tshon skud ltag pa'i phyogs nas rgyab ngos la phyir 'then/ g.yas kyi ral gri kha phyir bltas te dmigs pa gsal pos/ dang por mgrin pa'i tshon skud de nas lag pa g.yon g.yas/ rkang pa g.yon g.yas kyi tshon skud rnams bcas la/ dum bu lag g.yon pas bzung nas/ bsgrub bya'i lus la phyir la lan gsum bskor nas snod du bsags/ de'i bar la las kyi rdo rjes zan chung ngu re slob ma'i lus la dril du bcug nas chang bu phra mo nyer gcig bya/ gzhan la glud zan re gtad la lus mgo mjug thams cad dril nas ngar glud re re khrus sder rer 'dzin du bcug nad pa lta bu ma yin na khrus sder las glud med kyang rung / de nas tshon skud rnams bcad nas bskor zin pa'i rjes su/ rdo rje'i slob ma 'di rnams kyi nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad tshon skud dang chang bu 'bru sna'i phung po dang bcas pa la thim par gyur/ yang dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor/ rje btsun so sor 'brang ma chen mo sku mdog cung zad dkar ser zhal bzhi phyag brgyad ma dang / mgrin par stong chen mo rab tu 'joms ma sku mdog sngon mo zhal bzhi phyag brgyad ma dang / lte bar rma bya chen mo gser gyi mdog can zhal gsum phyag brgyad ma dang / snying kar gsang sngags rjes 'dzin pad+ma rā ga ltar dmar ba zhal gsum phyag bcu gnyis ma dang / dpral bar bsil ba'i tshal chen mo margad ltar ljang ba zhal gsum phyag drug ma rnams gnas te dus rgyun du mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad srung bar mdzad kyin 'dug pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces brjod/ de nas dkyil 'khor gyi shar/ slob dpon gyi mdun du/ sngags gyi thab de'i shar slob dpon la bstan la bzhag de'i g.yas su sngags gyi mchod pa dang chang bu dang tshon skud gnyis slar yang chung ngur byas pa dang /

spos dang me tog sna tshogs kyi bsreg rdzas rnams bshams/ mdun bskyed kyi shar ngos su me tog la spos rengs spar ba yang btsugs la bzhag nye 'khor du rnga dang sil snyan sogs rol mo bzang po sta gon byas la/ thab yak+ṣa dang bum chus bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las zhi ba'i thab khung dkar po rgyar khru gang pa/ zabs su khru phyed pa/ kha khyer mu ran sor bzhi pa/ kha khyer la rdo rje'i phreng bas bskor ba mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa phyogs bzhi dmar la me rlung ser bden bral ljang la dbang ldan sngo/ lte ba ljang khu ge sar ser po dang bcas pa'i dbus su praṃ dkar po/ shar du hūm̐ sngon po nas/ sku gsung thugs kyis brlabs pa'i bar bdag bskyed bzhin bya/ sa bon gyi yi ge de dag las 'od zer 'phros pas/ mdun bskyed kyi lha mo lnga'i thugs ka nas rang 'dra'i ye shes pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ ma lus sems can sogs sh+lau ka gcig dang / las kyi rdo rjes dkyil 'khor la phyag gsum byas/ pad kor sngon 'gros shar gyi spos dang me tog gi mtshon nas/ spyan drangs la rol mo dang bcas bzhin pas slob spyi 'gro ltar na slob dpon mdun bskyed la zhal ston dpon la phul la phyag bya/ de'i rgyab ngos nas bskor la/ g.yon phyogs nas pad kor sngon 'gro'i/ slob dpon gyis kyang pad kor sngon 'gros blangs la me tog dang spos kyi rtse nas cung zad thab kyi dbus su phul nas/ oṃ pañca/ rak+ṣa de ba tsakra maṇ+ḍal sa pa ri wā ra e h+ya hi dkyil 'khor gyi lha mo lnga las lha mo lnga mar me gcig las gnyis mched kyi tshul du spyan drangs nas/ thab kyi dam tshig pa la sib sib thim par gyur/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ yang thugs ka'i hūm̐ las sogs nas dbu brgyan pa'i bar bdag bskyed bzhin/ de nas mchod pa bsangs sbyangs nas/ rol mo'i bar yang sngags rgyas mchod/

rang bzhin dag pa sogs kyis bstod nas/ lce lde la me sbar la ma ṇi dha ri dang bum chus bsangs/ lha mo lnga'i thugs ka nas ye shes kyi me 'bar te slob ma rnams la 'tshe byed du gyur pa'i nad gdon sdig sgrib mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad bsreg par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ag+ne ye dz+wa la raṃ/ zhes rol mo dang bcas me sbar thab kyi shar lho'i ngos nas/ de nas mchod g.yog pas zan chang re dang tshon skud thum re phul la/ nyer gcig gi bar grangs kyang brjod/ slob dpon gyis g.yas mchod sbyin gyi phyag rgyas/ 'bru tshum re phul zhing / rdo rjes rin chen phug pa dang / /me yis bud shing sreg pa dang / /rlung gis sprin ni gtor ba dang / /nyi mas nags tshal skem byed dang / /bden pa'i tshig ni 'di dag gis/ /byad stems las rnams 'tshig par shog /spos dang me tog sna tshogs kyis/ sdig pa thams cad nges par bsam/ tad+ya thā/ hu me hu me/ ka kha li/ kha ra li/ dzu hī ni/ dza ba li/ ga ra ge ha ri ṇi/ shā ba ri/ shān+tiṃ/ pra shān+tiṃ swāhā/ dhā ba ni swāhā/ pra dhā ba ni swāhā/ gān+dhar+b+be swāhā/ pa laṅga ni swāhā/ sarba kā khor+dha kṛ ta be tā ṭa/ ts+tshe da ni swāhā/ e merman tra pa dair/ ma ma sa pa ri wā ra s+ya sarba/ satwa nañca sarba khor+dha kṛ ta/ be tā ro ṣa dhi man+t+ra bi ṣa yo gā/ sarba de baish+tsha di tā/ bhi di tā/ dzi tā/ sa rā dzi tā swāhā/ lha mo lnga'i sngags brjod/ gang dag sangs rgyas nas/ rdo rje'i slob ma 'di rnams kyi/ byad stems las rnams 'tshig gyur cig /rdo rje'i slob ma 'di rnams kyi sdig pa sgrib pa nad sogs nas/ mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad 'tshig par gyur cig zhi bar gyur cig shān+tiṃ ku ru swāhā/ pañca rak+ṣa sogs nyer mchod dang / rang bzhin dag pa sogs/ zhwa phud la/ bla ma dang rje btsun ma bsrung ba lnga'i lha tshogs rnams bdag cag rnams la dgongs su gsol/ khyed rnams la mkhyen brtse nus mthu bsam gyis mi khyab pa mnga' ba lags pas/

sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che dar zhing rgyas pa'i skyabs kyi 'og nas bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib thams cad byang zhing dag pa dang / rdo rje'i slob ma 'di rnams kyi sngon gyi las las gyur pa dang / 'phral gyi rkyen las gyur pa'i nad rims gdon bgegs mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad nye bar zhi ba dang / mthun rkyen tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor rigs rgyud thams cad gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs/ khyed kyis sems can sogs dang / badz+ra muḥ spos sna rol mo sogs sngar bzhin byas la me tog dkyil 'khor la phul/ ye shes pa rnams dkyil 'khor gyi lha mo lnga'i thugs kar gshegs/ dam tshig pa rnams bdag nyid la dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥm ṇi dha ri'i bum chus me la gtor la/ me'i dbal thams cad zhi bar gyur cig swāhā/ zhes brjod la thab ji ltar bde bar bskyal lo/ /de nas las kyi rdo rjes phrag pa g.yon la khrus ras gzar/ lag pa g.yon du khrus long snod bcas bzung ba dkyil 'khor la phyogs pas/ g.yas su bum pa bzung nas/ dpon slob thams cad kyis brjod bzhin pas/ 'di ni khrus mchog dpal dang ldan/ /thugs rje'i chu ni bla na med/ /byin rlabs ye shes chu yin te/ /ci 'dod dngos grub thams cad stsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri hūm̐/ ji ltar bltams pa nas/ shrī hūm̐/ rgyal ba'i sku la 'gyur ba mi mnga' yang / /sems can lus kyi sgrib pa sbyang slad du/ /rgyal ba'i sku la khrus chab 'di gsol bas/ /sems can lus kyi sgrib pa dag gyur cig /oṃ sarba nas shrī hūm̐/ rgyal ba'i gsung la 'gag pa mi mnga' yang / /sems can ngag gi sgrib pa sbyang slad du/ /rgyal ba'i gsung la༞ sems can ngag gi༞ oṃ sarba nas shrī hūm̐/ rgyal ba'i thugs la 'khrul pa mi mnga' yang / sems can yid kyi sgrib pa༞ rgyal ba'i thugs la༞

sems can yid kyi༞ oṃ nas/ shrī hūm̐/ rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs la nyon mongs mi mnga' yang / sems can lus ngag yid gsum༞ rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs la༞ sems can lus ngag yid gsum༞ oṃ nas/ shrī hūm̐/ de bzhin gshegs dang de yi sras rnams la/ /rin chen bum pa mang po spos kyi chus/ /yid 'ong legs pas bkang ba glu dang ni/ /rol mor bcas pa du mas sku khrus gsol/ /oṃ nas/ shrī hūm̐/ khrus re re gsol ba dang / rol mo re byed/ de dag sku la mtshungs pa med pa'i gos/ /gtsang ma dri rab bgos pas sku phyi'o/ /oṃ hūm̐ trāṃ hrīḥ.āḥka ya bhi shwa dha ni swāhā/ stong gsum kun tu dri mchog 'byung 'gyur ba/ /spos mchog rnams kyis thub dbang kun gyi sku/ /gser sbyangs btso ma byi dor byas pa ltar/ /'od chags 'bar ba de dag byugs par bgyi/ oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe āḥhūm̐/ srab 'jam yang ba lha yi gos/ /mi phyed rdo rje'i sku nyid la/ /mi phyed dad pas bdag 'bul na/ /bdag kyang rdo rje'i sku thob shog /oṃ badz+ra wasatra se āḥhūm̐/ de nas khrus chu bum par blugs la/ yang dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod cig bum pa'i nang na bcom ldan 'das ma srung ba lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs kyi sku'i cha shas las byung ba'i bdud rtsi'i rgyun bkrus pa tsam gyis nad gdon mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad sel bar nus pa des bkrus pas/ khyed rang rnams kyis tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib nad gdon mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad dud khu'i rnam par nag nur te dag song ba'i mos pa mdzod cig ces dang / slob ma rnams kyis khrus sder glud bcas lag pa g.yon pas bzung / g.yas pas khrus byas la/ ma ṇi dha ri sogs gtso mo lnga'i sngags dang / rdo rje'i slob ma 'di rnams kyi sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad shin+taṃ ku ru ye swāhā/ de bzhin du/ nad thams cad༞ rims thams cad༞

gdon thams cad༞ nye bar 'tshe ba thams cad༞ dus ma yin pa'i 'chi ba thams cad༞ 'khon thams cad༞ grib thams cad༞ byad thams cad༞ byur thams cad༞ skal ba ngan pa thams cad༞ ltas ngan pa thams cad༞ mtshan ma ngan pa thams cad༞ rmi lam ngan pa thams cad༞ bkra mi shis pa thams cad༞ mtshan mo nag mo'i gdon thams cad༞ dus kyi zhags pa thams cad༞ gshin rje'i pho nya thams cad༞ bgegs dang log 'dren thams cad ces pa re re'i mthar shān+tiṃ ku ru ye swāhā/ de nas khrus chu cung zad khar 'dzin du bcug la/ 'di re zhig khar bzung la cung zad nas skyugs shig ces pa dang / glud de'i mgo la 'pho gtong dgos so/ /zhes dang / bum chu ku shas slob ma la 'thor bzhin du/ stong chen las/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi gzi brjid dang / /rang rgyal dag gi gzi brjid dang / /dgra bcom rnams kyi mthu dag dang / /gsang sngags 'dzin pa thams cad dang / /shā ri'i bu yi shes rab dang / /mo'u 'gal bu yi rdzu 'phrul dang / /ma 'gag pa yi mig dang ni/ /'od srungs sbyangs pa'i yon tan dang / /kauṇ+ḍa n+ya yi sngar thob dang / /kun dga' bo yi thos pa dang / /tshangs pa lha yi byams pa dang / /brgya byin gyi ni dbang rnams dang / /'jig rten skyong ba'i yul rnams dang / /dbang phyug chen po'i stobs dag dang / /sde dpon rnams kyi mthu dag dang / /'phrog ma'i gzi brjid rdzu 'phrul dang / /de dag rnams kyi mthu dang gzis/ /slob ma'i/ che ge mo'i dug ni dug med shog /dug med dug rnams 'jig byed shog /s+yā+ād+ya the dan/ ha ri ke shi/ na ke li/ ro hi re/ a ma re/ an+ḍa re/ pan+ḍa re/ ka ḍa ke ke yu re/ ha se ha se ha re/ kha se kha se/ kha raṃ ge ma ru ga ha ne swāhā/ mu mu k+ṣu swāhā/ hi le swāhā/ mi le swāhā/ 'bras dang rma dang shu ba dang / /g.yan pa dang ni 'brum bu dang / /lhog pa dang ni g.ya' ba ni/ /bdun pa lags te rab tu bcom/ /'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum/ /'di dag 'jig rten dug gsum ste/

/bcom ldan sangs rgyas dug mi mnga'/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyis dug bcom mo/ /de bzhin du/ 'dod chags sogs/ chos༞ dge 'dun༞ sa ni dug gi pha yin te/ /sa ni dug gi ma yang yin/ /bden pa'i bden tshig 'di dag gis/ /'di rnams dug ni dug med shog /dug gsum sa yi nang du song / /gang ba'i nang du dug song zhig /chu/ me/ rlung / gsum la yang de bzhin sbyar/ dug dbyung gnyis pa ni/ na mo bud+dhā ya/ na mo dharmā ya/ na maḥsaṃ ghā ya/ na maḥsur+wa ṇa/ a ba bha sa s+ya/ ma yu rā dz+nyā/ na mo ma hā sūr+yai bi d+ya ra dz+nyā+ai/ tad+ya thā/ sid+dhe su sid+dhi mo tsa ni/ mo k+ṣa ni/ muka te/ bi mug te/ a ma le/ bi ma le/ nirma le/ an+ḍa re/ paṇ+ḍa re/ maṅga la/ maṃ ga l+ye hi ra ṣ+ye/ hi ra ṣ+ye/ garbe/ rat+ne/ rat+na gar+bha/ bha dre su bha dre/ sa man+ta bha dre/ sarba ar+tha sā dha ni/ sa ra ma ar+tha sā dha ni/ sarbā nar+tha/ pra sha ma ṇi/ sarba maṅgaṃl/ sā dha ni sarba maṃ ga laṃ bā dha ni/ ma na si/ mā na si/ ma hā mā na si/ ad bhu te/ a d+ya bhu te/ mug te/ mo tsa ni/ mo k+ṣa ni/ a ts+yu te/ a ra dze/ bi ra dze/ bi ma le/ a mṛ te/ a ma re/ a ma ra ṇi/ bra h+me/ bra h+me swa re/ pur ṇ+ṇe pur ṇ+ṇe/ ma no ra the/ mṛ ta pañji wa ni/ shrī bha dre/ tsan+d+re tsan+d+ra pra bha/ sūr+ye sūr+ya/ kan+te/ bī ta bha ye/ su war+ṇe/ brah+ma gho ṣe/ brah+ma dzuṣ+ṭe/ sarba tra/ a pra ti ha te rak+ṣa rak+ṣa/ maṃ ma no dam swāhā/ sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo/ rdo rje slob ma rnams la/ che ge mo la dge ba dang / che ge mo la bsrung bar mdzad du gsol/ che ge mo lo brgya 'tsho bar gyur cig ston brgya mthong bar gyur cig tad+ya thā/ hu tsi gu tsi/ ghu tsi mu tsi swāhā/ sangs rgyas kyi gzi brjid kyis dug nges par bcom mo/ /dug nges par bcom mo zhes pa 'og ma kun la'ang sbyar te/ rang sangs rgyas kyis gzi brjid kyis/ dgra bcom pa'i gzi brjid kyis/ phyir mi 'ong ba'i gzi brjid kyis/

lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i gzi brjid kyis/ rgyun du zhugs pa'i gzi brjid kyis/ bden par smra ba'i gzi brjid kyis༞ tshangs pa'i be con gyis༞ dbang po'i rdo rjes༞ khyab 'jug gi 'khor los༞ me lha'i me dbal gyis༞ chu lha'i zhags pas༞ lha ma yin gyi sgyus༞ klu'i rig sngags kyis༞ drag po'i mdung rtses༞ skem byed kyis mdung thung gis dug nges par bcom mo/ /rig sngags kyi rgyal mo rma bya chen mos dug bcom mo/ /dug nges par bcom mo/ /dug sa'i nang du song zhig chu'i༞ me'i༞ rlung gi nang du song zhig che ge mo'i dug thams cad dang / be'u lta bu'i dug dang / ha la ha la'i dug dang / nag po brtsegs pa'i dug dang / mche ba'i dug dang / rtsa ba'i dug dang / phye ma'i dug dang / lta ba'i dug dang / glog gi dug dang / sprin gyi dug dang / sbrul gyi dug dang / byi ba'i dug dang / srin bu ke ta'i dug dang / lu ti'i dug dang / ka na bha'i dug dang / sbal pa'i dug dang / sbrang bu'i dug dang / ba ti ri'i dug dang / tre ma bu ga'i dug dang / trai la ta'i dug dang / mi'i dug dang / sdig pa'i dug dang / mi ma yin pa'i dug dang / dogs pa'i dug dang / sman gyi dug dang / rig sngags kyi dug dang / dug thams cad las bde legs su gyur cig swāhā/ de nas g.yas byabs srung dang / med na ku sha rma bya dang bcas pas/ g.yon me long la slob ma'i gzugs 'char du bcug pa'i steng du byabs nas/ mthar de nyid chu nang gi ngar glud la thim par bsams nas mar la gcig byabs pas ngar glud de nyid bsgrub bya'i phung khams skye mched ji lta bar gyur nas gnod byed kyi longs spyod du bsam pa 'di yang gzhan na med do/ /de ltar bkrus pas ma song ba'i nad gdon lhag ma de dag glud de'i mgo la nag bun bun byabs te bskyur ba'i mos pa mdzod/ ma ṇi dha ri sogs lha mo lnga'i sngags dang rdo rje slob ma rnams kyi sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad a pa na ye swā hā nas/

bgegs dang log par 'dren pa thams cad a pa na ye swā hā bar brjod la/ nad gdon mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad sman pa mkhas pas skyugs sman btang ba ltar nag rgyangs te skyugs pa'i mos pa byas glud de'i mgo la skyugs shig ces kha nang gi chu 'pho/ de nas slob dpon skad cig gis gshin rje gshed kyi nga rgyal du langs la/ g.yas byabs srung 'phyar bas/ na mo rje btsun sogs nas/ 'tshe bar byed pa'i 'byung po gdon bgegs kyi rigs thams cad glud 'dis tshim par gyis la zhi ba'i sems dang ldan pas/ rdo rje'i slob ma 'di rnams la ma gnod ma 'tshe bar rang rang so so'i gnas su dengs shig 'di ltar bcom ldan rdo rje 'chang gi bka' thos nas myur ba nyid du song zhig gang dag mi 'gro ba de dag thams cad phyag na rdo rje hūm̐ zhes bya ba rab tu khros pa'i bzhin 'bar ba can gyis ye shes kyi rdo rje me 'bar kun tu 'bar/ rab tu 'bar/ me lce gcig tu gyur pas mgo bo tshal pa brgyar 'gas par 'gyur ro/ /oṃ āḥkro te kā ya mān+ta ka hūm̐/ zhes yungs kar gyi brabs/ gu gul gyis bdugs/ rol mo drag po dang bcas glud rnams phyir dor ro/ /de nas khyod rang rnams slob dpon gyi lag gi rdo rje la 'jus te langs la thal mo spyi bor sbyor la re zhig bzhugs shig ces dang / rol mo dang bcas pas bslangs la/ stong chen las/ sangs rgyas rnams ni bdud las rgyal/ /chos ni chos ma yin las so/ /dge 'dun mu stegs rnams las rgyal/ /dbang po lha min rnams las rgyal/ /lha min zla ba las ni rgyal/ /nam mkha' lding ni rgya mtsho las/ /me ni shing rnams kun las rgyal/ /chu ni me las rgyal bar 'gyur/ /rlung ni sprin las rnam par rgyal/ rdo rje yis ni rin chen phug /lha rnams bden par rab tu gnas/ sa yang bden par gnas pa lags/ /sangs rgyas dang ni chos kyang bden/ /bden pa rgyal gyur brdzun ma lags/

/s+yād+ya the dan/ a mṛ te/ a gra puṣ+pe/ ba hu pha le/ ni bā ra ṇi/ sarba ar+tha sā dha ni/ a pa ra dzi ti/ dhā rā dha ra ṇi/ gu h+ya gat+te/ gau ta me/ gub+ta ma ti/ dzam+bha ni swāhā/ pra dzam+bha ni swāhā/ ba la pra bhañca ni swāhā/ dza ye swāhā/ bi dza ye swāhā/ dza ya bhi dza ya swāhā/ sdig pa thams cad rab tu pham phyir rgol ba ni kun las rgyal ba/ swāhā/ dza ya dza ya/ zhes pas sngar gyi gdan de las bzhengs te slar yang gdan gsar pa dkar po gcig gi steng du bzhugs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces gdan thog la me tog gtor nas sngar bzhin 'khod pa la/ las kyi rdo rjes me tog dgram bsdus nas/ oṃ badz+ra bhū mi āḥhūm̐/ gzhi rin po che dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi'i steng du/ oṃ badz+ra re khe āḥhūm̐/ phyi lcags ri'i khor yug mu khyud kyis bskor ba'i dbus su hūm̐/ ri'i rgyal po ri rab/ shar lus 'phags po/ lho 'dzam bu gling / nub ba glang spyod/ byang sgra mi snyan/ zla ba/ nyi ma/ dbus su lha dang mi'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa thams cad kyis yongs su gang ba 'di nyid/ bla ma dang rje btsun so sor 'brang ma tha mi dad pa la rigs gtad zab mo zhu ba'i yon du zhes sbyar la phul lo/ /de nas slob dpon gyis nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang rin po che thob par bya/ de'i phyir du bsrung ba lnga'i dkyil 'khor du rigs gtad zab mo gsan snyam pa byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed pa gsal btab/ slob ma dge bshes mkhas pa rnams la 'dir spyir chos bshad dang / khyad par rgyud sde'i dbye bsdu/ gzungs grwa lnga bye brag tu zab pa'i tshul sogs bshad do/ /da ltar bshams pa'i maṇ+ḍal 'di nyid maṇ+ḍal snod bcud phun sum tshogs par dmigs/ de bla ma dang rje btsun so sor 'brang ma la yon du phul nas bdag la rigs gtad pa'i dbang bskur ba bstsal du gsol snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/

oṃ mu ne mu ne ba re༞ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rigs pa'i dbang bskur ba/ rdo rje'i go cha chen po'i phyag rgyas btab pa thams cad kyis bdag la dbang bskur du gsol/ sarba ta thā ga ta hrī da ya a dhiṣ+ṭha te badz+ra swāhā/ lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ slob dpon gyis lha la gsol ba btab pa ni/ zhwa phud dril bu dkrol dkyil 'khor la me tog 'thor zhing / oṃ mu ne sogs/ rdo rje'i slob ma 'di rnams kyis mngon par dbang bskur du gsol sogs gsum/ zhes bya bas gsol pa btab nas/ da yang dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod cig bum pa'i nang na bcom ldan 'das ma bsrung ba lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams mngon sum du bzhugs pa de'i sku lus las byung ba'i byang chub kyi sems kyi chu rgyun gyis khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo nas dbang bskur bas lus ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis khrig mer gyis gang / tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib nyes ltung thams cad byang zhing dag bsrung ba lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs thams cad kyi rgyud byin gyis brlabs pa'i mos pa mdzod cig ces dang / bum pa spyi bor bzhag bum chu blud rol mo byas la/ oṃ ma ṇi sogs gtso mo lnga'i sngags kyi rjes su/ oṃ badz+ra a bhi ṣiñca maṃ/ zhes pas/ gtso mo lnga'i chu'i dbang bskur ba dang / oṃ in+d+ra ye swā hā nas/ oṃ pṛ thi wi de wi swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra a bhi ṣiñca maṃ/ zhes pas/ phyogs skyong ba bcu'i/ oṃ gong gi gza' sngags las byung / golka nas/ ke ta ye swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra a bhi ṣiñca maṃ/ zhes pas gza' chen po dgu'i chus/ oṃ kirti nas/ oṃ bha ra nī swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra a bhi ṣiñca maṃ/ zhes pas rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad kyi chus oṃ dh+riṣ+ṭa nas/ ṇa ye swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra a bhi ṣiñca maṃ/ zhes pas rgyal po chen po bzhi'i chu'i dbang bskur ba ste de ltar lha thams cad kyi chus dbang bskur bas lus ye shes kyi nas/

mos pa mdzod kyi bar sngar bzhin brjod/ de la rig pa gtad pa'i cho ga byed pa la/ rig pa gtad pa zhes bya ba ni/ dper na 'jig rten na sgos dpon sgrog pa lta bu yin te/ de yang dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ mdun gyi ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor 'di nyid rje btsun so sor 'brang ma srung ba lnga'i dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa mngon sum lta bur 'od kyi rang bzhin du khra lam mer bzhugs pa steng gi nam mkha' la de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga'i dkyil 'khor dang / bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa nyan thos dang byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun dang / 'jig rten skyong ba'i tshogs dang bcas pa bzhugs nas dgongs pa rtse gcig tu mdzad par bsam/ de'i mdun na khyed rang rnams lus gus pas thal mo sbyar/ sems ma yengs par/ slob dpon gyi cho ga'i tshig rjes su gtad la/ nged kyis rdo rje'i slob ma 'di rnams la bsrung du gsol/ zhes brjod pa'i dus su/ khyed rang rnams kyang bdag la bsrung du gsol/ bsrung du gsol snyam pa'i mos gus dung dung pa mdzod cig de ltar dkyil 'khor pa'i lha tshogs thams cad dang de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad/ sems dpa' rnams kyis bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad brjod/ sems ma rnams kyis gdugs dang rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dang / gur gum dang me tog la sogs pa'i char 'bebs shing rnga bo che la sogs pa'i sgra sgrog khro bo khro mos bar chad kyi bgegs sel ba dang bcas pa la/ slob dpon gyis rig pa gtad pa byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces ku shas bum chu slob ma rnams la 'thor bzhin pas/ na mo bud+dha ya/ sor 'brang las/ na mo dharma ya/ na maḥsaṅgha ya/ na mo/ na maḥsarba bud+dha bo dhi satwa dharma saṃ ghe bh+ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ bi pu la gar+bhe/ oṃ bi pu la bi ma le/ bi ma le gar+bhe/ bi ma le/ dza ya gar+bhe/ badz+ra dz+wa la gar+bhe/ ga ti ga ha ne/

ga ga na bi sho dha ne/ sarba pā paṃ bi sho dha ne/ oṃ gu na ba ti/ ga ga na bi/ tsa ri ṇi/ ga ga ri ṇi ga ga ri ṇi/ gi ri gi ri/ gi ri ṇi gi ri ṇi/ ga ma ri ga ma ri/ ha ga ha ga gar+ghā ri gar+ghā ri/ ga ga ri ga ga ri/ gam+bhā ri gam+bhā ri/ ga bhi ga bhi/ ga hi ga hi/ ga ma ni/ ga ma ni/ ga ri ga ri/ gu ru gu ru/ gu bha gu bha/ gu ha gu ha/ gu ru ṇi/ tsa le gu ha ṇi/ gu ha ni gu ru ṇi/ gu ru ṇi/ tsu lu tsu lu/ tsa le tsa le/ mu tsi le/ mu tsi le/ dza ye bi dza ye/ sarba bha ya bi ga te/ sarba gar+bha saṃ rak+ṣa ṇi/ si ri si ri/ bhi ri bhi ri/ mi ri mi ri/ gi ri gi ri/ ghi ri ghi ri/ bcom ldan 'das ma sems can 'dren ma/ kun nas 'dren ma/ dgra thams cad 'joms par mdzad ma/ rdo rje slob ma rnams la zhes gzhan rnams la'ang shes par bya'o/ che ge mo'i 'jigs pa thams cad dang / gnod pa thams cad dang / nad 'go ba thams cad dang / nad thams cad las srung du gsol/ bsrung du gsol/ tsi ri tsi ri/ dhi ri dhi ri/ bi ga ta/ ā ba ra ṇi/ bi sho dha ni/ bi bi dha/ ā ba ra ṇi/ bi nā sha ni/ mu ni mu ni/ mu tsi mu tsi/ mu li mu li/ tsi li tsi li/ ki li ki li/ mi li mi li/ ka ma le/ bi ma le/ dza ye bhi dza ye dza yā/ ba he dza ya ba ti/ bcom ldan 'das ma rin po che'i cod pan dang / phreng ba mnga' ba cha byad rnam pa sna tshogs mnga' ba/ bcom ldan 'das ma rig pa'i lha mo chen mo/ sdig pa thams cad rnam par sbyongs ba/ che ge mo la thams cad du kun nas bsrung du gsol/ bsrung du gsol/ hu ru hu ru/ mu ru mu ru/ mgon ma mchis pa/ skyabs ma mchis pa/ dpung gnyen ma mchis pa/ che ge mo la bsrung du gsol/ bsrung du gsol/ che ge mo'i sdug bsngal thams cad las thar bar mdzad du gsol/ tsaṇ+ḍe tsaṇ+ḍe/ tsaṇ+ḍe tsaṇ+ḍe/ tsaṇ+ḍi ni tsaṇ+ḍi ni/ be ga ba ti/ sarba duṣ+ṭa ni bā ra ṇi/ bi dza ya/ bā hi ni/ hu ru hu ru/ mu ru mu ru/ tsu ru tsu ru/

tu ru tu ru/ ā yuḥsā la ni/ su ra ba ra pra ma tha ni/ sarba de ba ga ṇa pū'u dzi te/ tsi ri tsi ri/ dhi ri dhi ri/ sa man+ta a ba lo ki te/ pra bhe pra bhe su pra bhe/ su pra bha bi shud+dhe/ sarba pā paṃ bi shud+dhe/ sarba pā paṃ bi shod+dha ni/ dhu ru dhu ru/ dha ra ṇi/ dha re/ dha ra dha ra/ su mu su mu/ mu su mu su/ ru ru tsa le/ tsā la ya dpal gyi sku mnga' ba/ che ge mo la gnod par sems pa las bskyab tu gsol/ che ge mo'i bsam pa rdzogs par mdzad du gsol/ dza ya ka ma le/ k+ṣi ni k+ṣi ni/ ba ra da/ oṃ ku she oṃ pad+ma bhi shud+dhe/ sho dha ya sho dha ya/ shud+dhe shud+dhe/ bha ra bha ra/ bhi ri bhi ri/ bhu ru bhu ru/ maṃ ga la bi shud+dhe/ sa bi tra mu khi khat+ge ni khat+ge ni/ kha ra kha ra/ dz+wa li ta shi kha re/ sa man+ta a ba lo ki ta pra bhe su pra bhe bī shud+dhe/ sa man+ta pra sa ri tā/ ā ba bhā si ta shud+dhe/ dz+wa la dz+wa la/ sarba de ba ga ṇa/ gra ha nak+ṣa tra/ sa ma a kar+ṣa ṇi/ sa t+ya bra te/ oṃ hri trāṃ ta ra ta ra/ tā ra ya/ tā ra ya/ glang po che'i lta stangs kyis gzigs ma/ che ge mo bsgral du gsol/ la hu la hu/ hu lu hu lu/ hu du hu du/ tu ru tu ru/ ki ni ki ni/ k+ṣi ṇi k+ṣi ṇi/ hu ṇi hu ṇi/ sarba gra ha bhak+ṣa ni/ siṃ ga le siṃ ga le/ mu tsu mu tsu/ tsu mu tsu mu/ su mu su mu/ su bi tsa re/ ta ra ta ra/ bcom ldan 'das ma glang po che'i lta stangs kyis gzigs ma/ thams cad du kun nas phyogs thams cad bcings pa dang / rdo rje'i ra ba dang / rdo rje'i zhags pas bcings pas che ge mo 'jigs pa chen po brgyad las bsgral du gsol/ badz+ra dz+wa la bi shud+dhe/ bhu ri bhu ri/ bha ga ba ti/ gar+bha saṃ sho dha ni ku k+ṣi sam pu'u ra ṇi/ dz+wa la dz+wa la/ tsa la tsa la/ dz+wa li ni/ lha'i chus kun tu char dbab tu gsol/ a mṛ ta bar+ṣa ṇi de ba ta/ a ba tā ra ṇi/ bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung rab bdud rtsi mchog gi sku dang ldan pas/

che ge mo la dbang bskur du gsol/ 'thab pa dang / 'thab mo dang / rtsod pa dang / 'gyod pa dang / rmi lam ngan pa dang / ltas ngan pa dang / bkra mi shis pa dang / sdig pa thams cad rnam par sbyong ba/ gnod sbyin dang / srin po dang / klu thams cad 'joms pa/ gnod pas 'jigs skrag pa/ che ge'i 'jigs pa thams cad dang / gnod pa thams cad dang / nad 'go ba thams cad dang / nad thams cad las/ thams cad du rtag par bsrung du gsol/ bsrung du gsol/ ba la ba la/ ba la ba ti/ dza ya dza ya/ bi dza ya bi dza ya/ thams cad du dus kun tu che ge mo rgyal bar mdzad du gsol/ che ge mo ma rig pa chen mo 'di grub par mdzad du gsol/ dkyil 'khor chen po bsgrub tu gsol/ gsang sngags rnams bsgrub tu gsol/ bgegs rnams gzhom du gsol/ dza ya dza ya sid+dhi sid+dhi/ sidh+ya sidh+ya/ budh+ya budh+ya/ pu'u ra ya/ pu'u ra ya/ pu'u ra ṇi/ pu'u ra ya/ che ge mo'i bsam pa rdzogs par mdzad du gsol/ rig pa thams cad las byung ba'i sku/ rgyal ba lhag par rgyal ba can/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po rnam par dag pa/ bcom ldan 'das ma bzhugs su gsol/ bzhugs su gsol/ dam tshig bskyang du gsol/ 'jigs pa mi bzad pa chen po brgyad las che ge mo la gzigs su gsol/ sa ra sa ra/ pra sa ra pra sa ra/ sarba a ba ra ṇa bi sho dha ni/ sa man+ta ā kā ra man+ḍal bi shud+dhe/ bi ga te bi ga ta/ bi ga ta ma le/ sarba ma la bi sho dha ni sarba maṃ ga la bi ga la bi shud+dhe/ sarba a maṃ ga la bi sho dha ni/ k+ṣi ṇi k+ṣi ṇi/ sarba pā paṃ bi shud+dhe/ ma ma bi ga te/ dza ya ba ti/ te dzo ba ti/ badz+ra ba ti/ 'jig rten gsum du byin gyis brlabs pa la swāhā/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis spyi bo nas dbang bskur ba la swāhā/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis dbang bskur ba la swāhā/ lha thams cad kyis dbang bskur ba la swāhā/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi snying pos byin gyis brlabs la swāhā/

de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dam tshig grub pa la swāhā/ dbang po dang nye ba'i dbang po dang ldan pa dbang pos bltas pa la swāhā/ tshangs pa dang / tshangs pa la gnas pa la swāhā/ khyab 'jug gi phyag byas pa la swāhā/ dbang phyug chen pos phyag 'tshal zhing mchod pa la swāhā/ rdo rje 'chang lag na rdo rje'i stobs dang / brtson 'grus kyis byin gyis brlabs pa la swāhā/ yul 'khor srung la swāhā/ 'phags skyes po la swāhā/ mig mi bzang la swāhā/ rnam thos kyi bu la swāhā/ rgyal po chen po bzhis phyag byas pa la swāhā/ gshin rje la swāhā/ gshin rjes mchod cing phyag byas pa la swāhā/ chu lha la swāhā/ rlung lha la swāhā/ rlung lha chen po la swāhā/ me lha la swāhā/ klus rnam par bltas pa la swāhā/ lha'i tshogs rnams la swāhā/ klu'i tshogs rnams la swāhā/ gnod sbyin gyi tshogs rnams la swāhā/ srin po'i tshogs rnams la swāhā/ dri za'i tshogs rnams la swāhā/ lha ma yin gyi tshogs rnams la swāhā/ nam mkha' lding gi tshogs rnams la swāhā/ mi'am ci'i tshogs rnams la swāhā/ lto 'phye chen po rnams la swāhā/ mi rnams la swāhā/ mi ma yin pa rnams la swāhā/ gdon rnams la swāhā/ 'byung po rnams la swāhā/ yi dwags rnams la swāhā/ sha za rnams la swāhā/ brjed byed rnams la swāhā/ gnon po rnams la swāhā/ grul bum rnams la swāhā/ oṃ dhu ru dhu ru swāhā/ tu ru tu ru swāhā/ oṃ ku ru ku ru swāhā/ oṃ tsu ru tsu ru swāhā/ mu ru mu ru swāhā/ ha na ha na sarba sha truṃ swāhā/ da ha da ha sarba duṣ+ṭān swāhā/ pa tsa pa tsa sarba t+yir+thi ka pra t+ya mi trān swāhā/ gang dag che ge mo la mi phan par 'dod pa de dag thams cad kyi lus/ dz+wa la ya dz+wa la ya/ sarba duṣ+ṭa tsit+ta nān swāhā/ 'bar ba la swāhā/ rab tu 'bar ba la swāhā/ rdo rje 'bar ba la swāhā/ me lce 'bar ba la swāhā/ kun tu 'bar ba la swāhā/

nor bu bzang la swāhā/ gang ba bzang po la swāhā/ nag po chen po la swāhā/ ma mo'i tshogs la swāhā/ gnod sbyin mo rnams la swāhā/ srin mo nag mo rnams la swāhā/ nam mkha'i me mo rnams la swāhā/ rgya mtsho na gnas pa rnams la swāhā/ mtshan mo rgyu ba rnams la swāhā/ nyin mo rgyu ba rnams la swāhā/ dus gsum du rgyu ba rnams la swāhā/ dus su rgyu ba rnams la swāhā/ dus ma yin par rgyu ba rnams la swāhā/ zas su mngal za ba rnams la swāhā/ mngal 'dzin pa la swāhā/ hu lu hu lu swāhā/ oṃ swāhā/ swa swāhā/ bhu swāhā/ bhu ba swāhā/ bhur bhu ba swāhā/ bi ṭi bi ṭi swāhā/ tsi ṭi tsi ṭi swāhā/ ni ṭi ni ṭi swāhā/ dha ra ṇi swāhā/ dhā ra ṇi swāhā/ ag+ni swāhā/ te dzo bā yu swāhā/ tsi li tsi li swāhā/ si li si li swāhā/ mi li mi li swāhā/ bu dh+ya bu dh+ya swāhā/ si dh+ya si dh+ya swāhā/ maṇ+ḍa la ban+dhe swāhā/ sī mā ban+dhe swāhā/ dhā ra ṇi ban+dhe swāhā/ rgya dper med/ sarba sha trun/ bhañja ya bhañja ya swāhā/ dzam+bha ya dzam+bha ya swāhā/ satwam+bha ya satwam+bha ya swāhā/ tshin+dha tshin+dha swāhā/ bhin+dha bhin+dha swāhā/ bhañja bhañja swāhā/ mo ha ya mo ha ya swāhā/ ma ṇi bi shud+dhe swāhā/ sūr+ye sūr+ye bi shud+dhe swāhā/ tsan+d+re tsan+d+re pu 'ur ṇa tsan+d+re swāhā/ sho dha nai swāhā/ bi sho dha ni swāhā/ gra he bh+yaḥswāhā/ nak+ṣa tre bh+yaḥswāhā/ shi be bh+yaḥswāhā/ shān+ti bh+yaḥswāhā/ puṣ+ṭi bh+yaḥswāhā/ swa sat+ya na ye swāhā/ shi baṃ ka ri swāhā/ shaṃ ka ri swāhā/ shān+ti ka ri swāhā/ puṣ+ṭe ka ri swāhā/ ba la bar+dha ni swāhā/ ba la bar+dha ni ka ri swāhā/ shrī ka re swāhā/ shrī bar+dha ni swāhā/ shrī dz+wa ri ni swāhā/ mu tsi swāhā/ na mu tsi swāhā/ma ru tsi swāhā/ be ga ba ti swāhā/ oṃ/ bcom ldan 'das ma de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku mchog dri ma dang bral ba/

che ge mo'i sdig pa thams cad zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ che ge mo bde legs su gyur cig oṃ mu ni mu ni/ bi mu ni mu ni/ dha ri tsa li tsa la ni/ bha ga ba te/ bha ya bi ga te/ bha ya ha ri ṇi/ bo dhi bo dhi bho dha ya bho dha ya/ bur+dhi li bur+dhi li/ sarba ta thā ga ta hri da ya dzuṣ+ṭe swāhā/ oṃ mu ni mu ni ba re/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis rigs pa'i dbang bskur ba rdo rje'i go cha chen po'i phyag rgyas btab pa thams cad kyis che ge mo la dbang bskur du gsol/ sarba ta thā ga ta hrī da ya/ a dhiṣ+ṭha te badz+re ye swāhā/ klog pas byin rlabs che ba yin par gsungs nas rje mkhyen rab chos rje nyid kyang gal che dus re re tsam la lan gsum re klog par mdzad la/ phal cher ni thugs thog nas lan re mdzad mod/ /de'i rgyu mtshan ni sku zhang ches rje gong ma'i phyag dpe phyag dreg mthug po yod pa cig 'dug pas/ de las gzhan pa'i dpe ni med/ de'i phyag dreg rnams nyams kyis dogs nas/ ngos kyis blo thog nas byas pa yin/ zhes gsungs so/ /des dngos gzhi rig pa gtad pa'i cho ga grub/ da rjes bsrung ba lnga bya ba la/ dang po sngags kyis bsrung ba ni/ sngar gyi me long la bris pa'i sngags rnams bum pas bkrus pa'i bum chu slob ma rnams la ma ṇi dha ri brjod bzhin du byin la/ bzung du gzhug gal te sngags bris pa med na bum chu sngar bzhin gtor ro/ /de nas nad pa lta bu la 'di'i srung 'khor sogs ster na sngon du srung ba'i chings dang rab gnas grub par byas nas de nyid mgo mjug ma log par slob ma'i spyi bor reg nas lag tu gtad la/ ma ṇi dha ri sogs gtso mo sngags dang / 'di zungs shig chongs shig ma bral cig ces sbyin no/ /gnyis pa dmigs pas bsrung ba ni/ dmigs pa 'di bzhin du gyis shig slob dpon so sor 'brang mar gsal ba des/ khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor sna tshogs rdo rje zhags pa sna tshogs rdo rje gcig las gnyis gnyis las gsum/

gsum las dpag tu med par mched de lus kyi phyi rol thams cad sna tshogs rdo rje zhu lub kyi rnam par gtams pa des nad gdon mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad dus rgyun du bsrung ba byas pa'i mos pa mdzod ces spyi bor rdo rje rgya gram du bzhag la/ oṃ ma ṇi dha ri sogs gtso mo lnga'i sngags dang / rdo rje'i slob ma 'di rnams la sdig pa dang sgrib ba thams cad rak+ṣa rak+ṣaḥ log 'dren thams cad rak+ṣa rak+ṣaḥ'adi bar gsum sa lhas bsrung ba ni/ gnas so sor rdo rje rgya gram du bzhag cing / ma ṇi dha ri dang / spyi bor so sor 'brang ma chen mo sku mdog cung zad dkar ser sogs oṃ a mṛ ta wa re sogs/ phrag pa g.yas su stong chen mo sogs/ oṃ a mṛ ta bi le sogs/ phrag pa g.yon du rma bya chen mo sogs/ oṃ bi ma le sogs/ mchan khung g.yas su gsang sngags rjes 'dzin sogs/ oṃ bha ra sogs/ mchan khung g.yon du bsil ba'i tshal sogs nas/ tsam pa ka'i shing drung na bzhugs pa'o/ /de dag gi 'khor du steng gi cha la nam mkha' la phyogs skyong ba bcu/ gza' chen po dgu/ rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad/ rgyal po chen po sde bzhi dang bcas pa rnams bzhugs nas dus rgyun du khyod rang rnams la bsrung ba mdzad kyin 'dug pa'i mos pa mdzod/ bzhi pa rdzas kyi bsrung ba ni/ sngar gyi zas dkar gsum de la/ ma ṇi dha ri sogs gtso mo lnga'i sngags dang / bum chus byin gyis brlabs nas byin la/ stong chen las/ rdzogs sangs rnam par sangs rgyas tshe/ /'jig rten skyong bas phyogs bzhi nas/ /snod bzhi dag ni blangs nas su/ /bde bar gshegs la phul ba dang / /mthu yis gcig tu sprul mdzad pa/ /lha yi snod mchog de dag ni/ /bdud rtsi 'dra ba'i sman gyi gnas/ /stong pa'i phyag na bsnams gyur pa/ /bden pa'i tshig ni 'di dag gi /sman rnams bdud rtsir 'gyur bar shog sangs rgyas rnam gzigs gzi brjid dang /

/gtsug tor can gyi stobs rnams dang / /thams cad skyob kyi bden tshig dang / /log dad sel gyi ting 'dzin dang / /gser zhes bya ba'i ye shes dang / /'od srungs kyi ni rdzu 'phrul dang / /shākya seng ge'i mthu rnams kyis/ /sman rnams bdud rtsir 'gyur bar shog s+yad+yā the dan/ kha ṭe kha ṭe/ bi kha ṭe/ bi ma le ba la ma be/ ba le ba la ba te/ tsan+d+re tsa ra ṇi/ a mṛ ta nir+gho ṣe swāhā/ rlung las gyur dang mkhris las gyur/ /bad kan las gyur 'dus las gyur/ /nad rnams thams cad rab bcom ste/ /khyed la rtag tu bde legs shog /ces sman nam zas la brjod la drang nges/ lnga pa bden pa'i stobs brjod pa'i bsrung ba ni/ gsang sngags rjes 'dzin las/ bden pa bden pa'i tshig gang gis 'jig rten du sems can brjed ngas pa med pa'i chos can byung ba ni de bzhin gshegs pa'o/ /zhes yang dag par smra bas smra ba ni/ dus su yang dag smra bas smra ba yin no zhes bya ba dang / kun dga' bo gzhan yang tshangs par spyod pa la phan par bya ba'i phyir/ de bzhin gshegs pas tshig gsungs pa gang yin pa de dag dang / kun dga' bo gzhan yang tshig de dag gis bya ba gang byed pa'i don dang / phan pa dang / bde ba yang 'dis byed par 'gyur te/ s+yad+ya the dan swasatwi ma ti/ bi lu ma ti/ pra ha ra ma ti/ ka shu mad tshi/ nan da ma ti/ si ha gra he/ bi du ma ti/ a da kṛ ta/ ar+tha su driṣ+ṭa bhud+dhe/ bho ti ma te/ su hu du me te/ a la khū me/ a la mi te/ i ga ra sha ra/ a shu ha/ pra ga shi ni/ slob ma'i mgor rdo rje bzhag dril bu bsil zhing / kun dga' bo sa bon gyi rtsa ba bcu dang / sa bon gyi rtsa ba'i tshig bcu de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs pa yod do/ /kun dga' bo tshig de dag de bzhin gshegs pas gsung par 'gyur ro/ /ston par 'gyur ba yang yod do/ /de dag bstan pa 'di la zhugs pa'i mi rnams kyis khar brjod na gnod sbyin dang /

srin po rnams kyang bran bzhin du las byed par 'gyur ro/ /bden pa dang bden pa'i tshig gang gis phyir mi ldog pa'i tshig bden pa rnams la/ 'jig rten gyi tshig gi mchog dang / dge sbyong rnams kyi nang na/ dge sbyong skyed de zhes bya ba dang / de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ni/ 'jigs pa mi mnga'/ bag tsha ba mi mnga' ba ste/ mi skrag mi 'bros la/ 'jigs pa med cing 'jigs pa dang bral ba/ 'jigs pa dang 'jigs par byed pa spang ba dang / skyi bung zhes byed pa med pa'o/ /zhes yang dag par smra bas smra ba ni/ dus su yang dag par smra bas smra ba yin te/ bden pa dang bden pa'i tshig des/ rdo rje slob ma rnams la tshig 'og ma kun la 'gre ming 'di zhes bya ba la bde legs su gyur cig bden pa dang bden pa'i tshig gang gis tshul khrims dang / brtul zhugs dang / dka' thub dang / tshangs par spyod pa la gnas pa/ gang ci'ang rung ba de dag gi nang na ni/ 'phags pa dgyes pa'i tshul khrims mchog ces bya ste/ bden pa dang bden pa'i tshig des/ ming 'di zhes bya ba la bde legs su gyur cig gnas brtan rgyal po lta bu'i bu thu bo dang 'dra ba rab tu byung nas yun ring du lon pa/ tshangs par spyod pa dang / mngon par spyad pa rnams kyi mchog 'di lta ste/ dge slong kun shes kau ḍi n+ya dang / 'dod pa nyung ba/ sbyangs pa'i yon tan la gnas pa dang / chos shes pa rnams kyi mchog 'od srungs chen po dang / shes rab che ba dang / spobs pa che ba rnams kyi mchog shā ra dwa ti'i bu dang / rdzu 'phrul che ba dang / mthu che ba rnams kyi mchog mauṅgal gyi bu chen po dang / lha'i mig dang ldan pa rnams kyi mchog ma 'gags pa dang / mang du thos pa rnams kyi mchog kun dga' bo dang / 'dul ba 'dzin pa rnams kyi mchog nye ba 'khor dang / chos smra ba rnams kyi mchog byams pa'i bu gang po dang / bslab pa la gus pa rnams kyi mchog

sgra gcan 'dzin dang / mal cha dang stan bgo ba rnams kyi mchog gyad bu nor dang / seng ge'i sgra sgrog pa rnams kyi mchog bā ra dh+wa dza bsod snyoms len dang / khyim par dad pa bskyed par byed pa rnams kyi mchog nag po 'char ka dang / lha dang mis mchod pa rnams kyi mchog legs mthong gi bden pa dang / bden pa'i tshig des/ ming 'di zhes bya ba la bsrung bar bya'o/ /yongs su bskyab pa dang / yongs su gzung ba dang / yongs su bskyang ba dang zhi ba dang / bde legs su 'gyur ba dang / chad pa bzlog par bya'o/ /rgyal po'am/ chom rkun nam/ me'am/ chu'am/ dgra'am mi mdza' ba'am/ lam du 'gro ba'am/ lam gol bar 'gro ba'am/ gnyid log pa'am/ ra ro ba'am/ bag med pa las bsrung bar bya'o/ /bden pa dang / bden pa'i tshig gang gis sems can rkang pa med pa'am/ rkang gnyis pa'am/ rkang bzhi pa'am/ rkang mang ba'am/ gzugs can nam/ gzugs can ma yin pa'am/ 'du shes can nam/ 'du shes can ma yin pa'am/ 'du shes med 'du shes med min gyi sems can ji snyed pa de dag gi nang na ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa mchog ces bya ste bden pa dang / bden pa'i tshig des/ ming 'di zhes bya ba la bsrung bar bya'o/ /yongs su bskyab pa dang / yongs su gzung ba dang / zhi ba dang / bde legs su 'gyur ba dang / chad pa bzlog par bya'o/ /bden pa dang / bden pa'i tshig gang gis/ 'dus byas sam/ 'dus ma byas kyi chos ji snyed yod pa de dag gi nang nas ni/ 'dod chags dang bral ba mchog ces bya ste/ bden pa dang bden pa'i tshig des/ ming 'di zhes bya ba la bsrung bar bya'o/ /yongs su bskyab pa dang / yongs su gzung ba dang / zhi ba dang bde legs su 'gyur ba dang / chad pa bzlog par bya'o/ /bden pa dang bden pa'i tshig gang gis/ tshogs pa'am/ 'dus pa'am/ mang po'am/ 'khor ji snyed yod pa de dag gi nang nas ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i nyan thos kyi dge 'dun mchog ces bya ste/ bden pa dang / bden pa'i tshig des/

rgyal khams sam/ yul 'khor ram/ grong ngam/ grong rdal lam/ grong khyer ram/ khyim mam/ gnas sam/ zhing ngam/ nad pa 'di la bsrung bar bya'o/ /yongs su bskyab pa dang / yongs su gzung ba dang / yongs su bskyang ba dang / zhi ba dang / bde legs su 'gyur bar bya'o/ /mtshams gcad par bya'o/ /'byung po thams cad bzlog par bya'o/ /gzi brjid 'phrog pa rnams bzlog par bya'o/ /zhes brjod la bde legs dang bsrung ba dang bzlog par zhes pa rnams la slob ma la me tog gtor zhing dril bu re gsil/ bden pa dang / bden pa'i tshig gang gis bcom ldan 'das ma de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ngas/ 'dod chags dang / zhe sdang dang / gti mug zad par bya ba'i phyir/ chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong bstan pa dang / bshad pa dang / brjod pa'i bden pa dang / bden pa'i tshig des/ ming 'di zhes bya ba'i nad bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi zad par gyur cig med par༞ zhi bar༞ rab tu zhi bar gyur cig lan gcig gnyis gsum gang rung brjod nas spyi bor rdo rje bzung la/ spro lung pa kun smon gyis rgyal ba sras bcas bden pa'i byin rlabs dang / /rig pa'i rgyal mo rnams kyi byin rlabs kyis/ /'gro ba 'di la bdag gis bsrungs zin gyi/ /'di la sus kyang gnod pa ma byed cig /de nas slob ma la me tog gtor dril bu gsil zhing / stong chen las 'jig rten 'di'am yang dag gnas pa na/ /mtho ris dag na rin chen mchog yod pa/ /de bzhin gshegs pa lha yi lhar gyur pa/ /mi yi mchog dang 'di ni mtshungs pa med/ /de bas 'di ni rin chen mchog tu gsungs/ /bden pa de yis 'dir ni bde legs shog /zag pa chags bral bdud rtsi 'dus ma byas/ /shes pas shākya thub des rab tu phye/ /bdud rtsi zhi ba 'dus ma byas yin pa/ /chos de dang ni mtshungs pa gang yang med/ /de bas 'di ni rin chen mchog tu gsungs/

/bden pa de yis 'dir ni bde legs shog /mchog tu gang 'dod tshul bzhin rab brtan pa/ /ston pa'i rnal 'byor bla med rtag sgrub pa/ /rdo rje lta bur mig gnyis lam mthong ba/ /ting 'dzin de dang mnyam pa yod ma yin/ /de bas 'di ni rin chen mchog tu gsungs/ /bden pa de yis 'dir ni bde legs shog /gang zag chen po brgyad po rab bsngags shing / /gang dag zung bzhir brjod pa de dag ni/ /drang srong chen po gang zag mtshungs pa med/ /bde bar gshegs pas sbyin pa'i gnas zhes gsungs/ /de la byin na 'bras bu cher 'gyur te/ /zhing rab gshin la sa bon btab pa bzhin/ /'di ni dge 'dun rin chen mchog tu gsungs/ /bden pa de yis 'dir ni bde legs shog gang zag brtan pa'i yid kyis rab brtson zhing / gau ta ma yi bstan la 'jug byed pa/ /de dag thos nas bdud rtsi mchog thob ste/ /mun pa bsal nas mya ngan 'das thob pa/ /de bas 'di ni rin chen mchog tu gsungs/ /bden pa de yis 'dir ni bde legs shog /lta ba 'di la sbyar ma thag tu ni/ /'jig tshogs blta dang tshul khrims brtul zhugs dang / /the tshom dang ni nyon mongs gsum po dag /cig car spangs te 'phags pa'i bden mthong ba/ /des na dge 'dun rin chen mchog tu gsungs/ /bden pa de yis 'dir ni bde legs shog /lus sam ngag gam 'on te yid kyis kyang / /sdig pa rnam gsum nam yang mi byed cing / /glo bur byas na'ang 'chab par mi byed la/ /de ltar de dag lta bas 'dzin mi byed/ /de bas dge 'dun rin chen mchog tu gsungs/ /bden pa de yis 'dir ni bde legs shog /ji ltar dbang po'i sdong po gsar btsugs pa/ /phyogs bzhi'i rlung rnams kyis ni mi g.yo ltar/ 'phags pa'i lam gyis dam pa mthong ba yi/ /gang zag 'phags pa'i mchog rnams de bzhin no/ /des na dge 'dun rin chen mchog tu gsungs/ /bden pa de yis 'dir ni bde legs shog

/shes rab zab mo shin tu brtan pa yi/ /'phags pa'i bden pa su dag rnam sgom zhing / /lus kyang sbyin par yid la byas nas ni/ /de dag 'jigs pa brgyad dang phrad mi 'gyur/ /des na dge 'dun rin chen mchog tu gsungs/ bden pa de yis 'dir ni bde legs shog /ji ltar me ni rlung gis rab gtor ba/ /lag tu blangs te bgrang du med pa nyid/ /de ltar kun tu sbyor bas rab btang ba/ /sangs rgyas sras rnams bstan du med par 'gro/ /des na dge 'dun rin chen mchog tu gsungs/ /bden pa de yis 'dir ni bde legs shog /sems can gang dag 'gro dang mi 'gro ba/ /de dag thams cad 'dir ni bde gyur cig /ston mchog lha dang mis ni mchod 'os pa/ /sangs rgyas phyag 'tshal deng 'dir bde legs shog /sems can gang dag 'gro dang mi 'gro ba/ /de dag thams cad 'dir ni bde gyur cig /zhi ba chags bral lha mi'i mchod 'os pa/ /chos la phyag 'tshal deng 'dir bde legs shog /sems can gang dag 'gro dang mi 'gro ba/ /de dag thams cad 'dir ni bde gyur cig /tshogs kyi dam pa lha mi'i mchod 'os pa/ /dge 'dun phyag 'tshal deng 'dir bde legs shog /'byung po gang dag 'dir ni lhags gyur te/ /sa 'am 'on te mkha' la 'khod kyang rung / /skye dgu kun la rtag tu byams byed cing / /nyin dang mtshan du chos la spyod par shog /'dir ni rgyal ba dgra rgyal bden gang gis/ /shin tu bden pa gsungs shing rdzun med pa/ /bden pa de yis 'dir ni bde legs shog /deng kun 'jigs pa che las thar gyur cig /dza ya dza ya zhes dang / mthar rol chen yang mdzad do/ /des rje btsun so sor 'brang ma'i rig gtad zab mo gsan pa'i bka' drin gtang rag tu dmigs te maṇ+ḍal zhig 'bul bar zhu zhes dang / bka' drin gyi maṇ+ḍal phul la/ maṇ+ḍal snod bcud phun sum tshogs pa lus longs spyod dus gsum gyi dge rtsa dang bcas pa de nyid bka' drin gyi yon du phul nas cha shas nas bzhes te longs spyad du gsol snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/

deng nas brtsam ste sogs gsum/ des rje btsun ma bsrung ba lnga'i rig gtad dam gzungs grwa lnga'i dbang du grags pa de yongs su rdzogs par gsan pa yin pas/ des rang gzhan gyi don rgya che bar mdzad pa zhu/ bsod nams 'di yis thams cad gzigs pa nyid/ sogs bsngo bas rgyas btab nas slob ma rnams so sor btang ngo / /gsum pa rjes ni/ de nas dkyil 'khor gyi mchod pa rnams kha gsos la/ mchod pa bsangs sbyangs byin gyis brlabs slar yang chu gnyis nyer mchod rol mo rnams kyi sngags tshogs zhing gi skabs bzhin la rol chen dang / de bzhin du nyer mchod sogs kyi sngags kyi thad du 'dod yon lnga'i sngags dang sap+ta rat+na nas aṣ+ṭa maṅga la grā bh+yaḥzhes pa rnams bcug so so'i phyag rgya byas la mchod/ rang bzhin dag pa sogs/ bdag 'jug gi mgor bstan pa ltar mdor bsdus bstod la/ bla ma dang bcom ldan 'das ma bsrung ba lnga'i dkyil 'khor chen po'i lha tshogs sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ khyed rnams la thugs mkhyen pa'i ye shes brtse ba'i thugs rje mdzad pa'i phrin las bsam gyis mi khyab pa mnga' ba lags pas/ spyir gyi phan bde'i 'byung gnas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che phyogs dus gnas skabs thams cad du dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ bstan pa'i rtsa lag dpal ldan bla ma gong ma zhi bar gshegs pa rnams dang / sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs zag med kyi dgongs pa khyad par can gong nas gong du yongs su rdzogs pa'i phrin las mdzad du gsol/ da lta zhal bzhugs pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyis gtso mdzad/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa 'dzin pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen thams cad sku khams bzang zhing sku tshe brtan par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig pa dang sgrib pa dang dam tshig nyams chag thams cad zhi bar mdzad du gsol/

mtho ris dang / thar pa dang / thams cad mkhyen pa'i lam gyi bar du gcod pa dang / mi dge ba dang / nyon mongs pa dang / shes bya'i sgrib pa thams cad zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ gnas skabs su yang las dang nyon mongs pa'i dbang gis byung ba'i gnod pa dang / sdug bsngal gyi bye brag gdon chen po bco brgyad dang / bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu dang / log 'dren dang / gza' dang / rgyu skar dang / byad stems dang / pha rol gyi rig sngags las gyur pa'i gnod pa thams cad zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ me dang / chu dang / sa g.yo ba la sogs pa 'byung ba las gyur pa'i gnod pa dang / lo nyes dang / dgra'i gnod pa la sogs pa 'jigs pa chen po bcu drug dang / mu ge dang / mi nad dang / phyugs nad dang / nad bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi dang / dbul zhing phongs pa dang / dus ma yin par 'chi ba'i sdug bsngal dang / de dag gi rgyu bsam sbyor ngan pa thams cad zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ khyad par du yang bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad la sngon gyi las las gyur kyang rung / 'phral gyi rkyen las gyur kyang rung ste/ phyi nang gi nye bar 'tshe ba dang / lus sems la gnod par byed pa'i gdon bgegs dang nad la sogs pa/ lus kyi sdug bsngal ba dang / sems yid mi bde ba dang / skal ba ngan pa dang / rmi lam ngan pa dang / mtshan ma ngan pa dang / lus dang / srog dang / longs spyod dang / skal ba dang / dge ba sgrub pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ mdor na bdag gzhan sems can thams cad kyi gnas skabs su yang mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad nye bar zhi nas 'og min gyi srid pa'i mthar thug pa'i 'jig rten pa'i dngos grub mtha' dag 'grub pa dang / mthar thug sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa ma lus pa zhi ba'i phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub tshe 'di nyid la thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ bla ma dang bcom ldan 'das ma bsrung ba lnga'i dkyil 'khor chen po'i lha tshogs sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad bdag cag rnams la dgongs su gsol/

bdag cag rnams so so'i skye bor gyur pas sems nyon mongs pa can du gyur nas lus ngag yid gsum gyi spyod pa nyon mongs pa dang 'dres shing bag med par gyur nas/ rnal 'byor la dbang ma thob pas/ sems bying ba dang rgod pa'i dbang du gyur te/ ting nge 'dzin mi gsal ba dang / snyigs ma lnga'i dus kyi dbang gis nye bar mkho ba'i yo byad ma 'byor pa dang / mchod rdzas med cing ngan pa dang / brjed ngas pa dang / shes bzhin ma yin pa'i dbang du gyur nas/ cho ga lhag pa dang / chad pa dang / ser sna'i dbang gis mchod pa ngan cing chung ba dang / gti mug gi dbang gis rgyud sde nas 'byung ba'i cho ga bzhin du ma lcogs pa la sogs pa'i 'khrul zhing nongs pa thams cad bzod par bzhes nas bdag cag gi sa lam dang dngos grub kyi bar chad du mi 'gyur bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ oṃ badz+ra satwa sa mā ya/ ma nu pā la ya/ badz+ra sa twa twe no pa tiṣ+ṭha dri dho me bha wa/ su to ṣ+yo me bha wa/ a nu rak+to me bha wa/ su po ṣ+yo me bha wa/ sarba sid+dhi m+me pra yats+tsha/ sarba karma su tsa me/ tsit+ta shrī ya/ ku ru hūm̐/ ha ha ha ha ho/ bha ga wān sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra mā me muñca/ badz+ra bha wa/ ma hā sa ma ya satwa āḥ gsum/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang / /gang yang bdag rmongs blo yis ni/ /bgyis pa dang ni bgyid bstsal ba/ /de kun 'phags mas bzod par gsol/ /lhag pa dang ni chad pa dang / /cho ga'i yan lag nyams pa dang / /bdag gi brjed ngas ci mchis pa/ /de yang bzod par mdzad du gsol/ /ser sna'i dbang gyur mi mkhas pas/ /mchod pa ngan zhing bshams nyes pa/ /mgon po thugs rje che ldan pa/ /de yang bzod par mdzad du gsol/ /bag med spyod pa ma dag pas/ /rgyud las byung ba'i cho ga bzhin/ /ma lcogs 'khrul pa ci mchis pa/ /de yang bzod par mdzad du gsol/ /gang yang bdag blo gti mug pas/ /legs spyad 'di la nyes gyur gang / /gang phyir lus can skyabs gyur pa/

/de kun 'phags mas bzod par gsol/ /dge ba'i rtsa ba de yang sems can thams cad dang thun mong du byas te/ dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di dag gis bdag dang sems can thams cad 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i rgud pa thams cad dang bral bar gyur cig 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i phun sum tshogs pa thams cad dang yang dag par bden pa'i bde ba dang / yid bde ba nyid kyi mchog sangs rgyas su tshe 'di nyid la gyur cig bdag gi dge ba'i las rnams 'di dag gis/ /'jig rten du ni myur du sangs rgyas shog /'gro la phan phyir chos rnams ston bgyid cing / /sems can sdug bsngal mang pos gzir las sgrol/ /bdag dang 'gro la༞ nas/ de srid bcom ldan 'das ma 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor la brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+re swāhā/ zhes ras bris la me tog gtor la brtan bzhugs bya/ sangs rgyas rdzu 'phrul che dang sogs nas/ rab tu dang ba'i sems kyis bdag dang slob ma bsrung gyur cig ces dang / dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /bsrung ba lnga po 'grub gyur nas/ /'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa/ /de yi sa la 'god par shog /che ba'i che mchog ston mchog bla na med/ /chos rje nyi ma rgyas pa'i byin rlabs kyis/ /bdud dang bgegs rigs gnod pa'i dgra zhi nas/ /rtag tu dpal gnas nyin mtshan bkra shis shog /chos nyid bden pa'i chos mchog bla na med/ /dam chos bdud rtsi bden pa'i byin rlabs kyis/ /nyes pa'i skyon bral dge tshogs rnams 'phel ba/ /rtag tu dpal gnas༞ dge 'dun yon tan rin chen dpal 'bar ba/ /rgyal sras phan mdzad bden pa'i byin rlabs dang / /nyon mongs dug lngas gdung ba'i dgra zhi nas/ /rtag tu dpal gnas༞ tshangs dang lha dbang srung ma'i byin rlabs dang / /phan mdzad lha yi bkra shis gnas gyur te/ /dge legs bsam pa yid bzhin 'grub pa dang / /tshe ring nad med bde skyid ldan par shog

/'byung po gang dag 'dir ni lhags gyur nas/ /sa'am 'on te bar snang 'khod pa dag /skye dgu rnams la rtag tu byams byed pas/ /nyin dang mtshan du chos la spyod par shog /'dir ni rgyal ba dgra rgyal bden gang gis/ /rtag tu bden par gsung zhing brdzun med pa/ /bden pa de yis deng 'dir bde legs shog /deng 'dir 'jigs pa che las thar gyur cig /phyogs dang dus dang gnas skabs thams cad du/ /bkra shis dang bde legs chen pos khyab par gyur cig dza ya dza ya su dza ya/ de nas bum pa dang mchod gtor dman pa sogs bsdus la las kyi rjes mi mngon par bya zhing / ras bris kyi rdul rnams phyis la rten gyi gral du bzhugs su gsol/ rang gtso mo'i nga rgyal gyis dus kun tu gnas pas bstan pa dang sems can gyi don du ci 'gyur gyi las bya'o/ /de ltar na dbang bskur ba'i tshe dmigs pa ji ltar 'dzin dang / slob ma la dam tshig gi mtshams sbyor tshul sogs/ gsung bzhin zhib pa rang zhig gyis gsungs pas lhag chad med par bkod pa'o/ / zhes bco brgyad 'jam dbyangs rgyal mtshan gyis gsungs so/ /gnyis pa rdul tshon gyi steng nas sgrub mchod byed na/ de'i khyad par gyi chos la'ang gsum/ sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ rjes so/ /dang po la/ yo byad bsham pa'i tshul ni/ gtor ma gnyis yungs chu sogs thig tshon/ gzhan phal cher sngon du bstan pa bzhin no/ /de nas gso sbyong len par 'dod na/ tho rangs snga bar khrus byas nas/ langs la/ rang gi snying ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ rje btsun bsrung ba lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs la bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dngos su phyag 'tshal zhing / gang gi drin gyis bde chen sogs/ sangs rgyas kun gyi sogs/ bla ma dang ni rje btsun so sor 'brang ma dang sogs/ mgon po thugs rje che ldan sogs/ sh+lau ka bzhi/

'jig rten 'dren pa'i sogs/ skyon gyis ma gos sogs/ lha dang lha min sogs/ sngon tshe bcom ldan 'das kyi sogs/ phyag byar 'os pa sogs/ ji snyed su dag nas/ phyir bsngo'o yi bar dang / de nas tsog pur thal mo sbyar la/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang / bcom ldan 'das ma bsrung ba lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ ji ltar sngon gyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rta cang shes lta bu/ glang po chen po bya ba byas shing / byed pa byas pa/ khur bor ba/ rang gi don rjes su thob pa/ srid par kun tu sbyor ba yongs su zad pa/ yang dag pa'i bka'/ legs par rnam par grol ba'i thugs/ legs par rnam par grol ba'i shes rab can/ de dag gis sems can thams cad kyi don gyi phyir dang / phan par bya ba'i phyir dang / grol bar bya ba'i phyir dang / nad med par bya ba'i phyir dang / mu ge med par bya ba'i phyir dang / byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos rnams yongs su rdzogs par bya ba'i phyir dang / bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par bya ba'i phyir/ gso sbyong nges par mdzad pa de bzhin du/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas kyang / rig pa 'dzin pa zhes gsung rgyun/ dus 'di nas bzung ste/ ji srid sang nyi ma ma shar gyi bar du sems can thams cad kyi don gyi phyir dang / phan par bya ba'i phyir dang / grol bar bya ba'i phyir dang / nad med par bya ba'i phyir dang / mu ge med par bya ba'i phyir dang / byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos rnams yongs su rdzogs par bya ba'i phyir dang / bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par bya ba'i phyir/ gso sbyong gi sdom pa nges par yang dag par blang bar bgyi'o/ /deng nas srog gcod mi bya zhing / /gzhan gyi nor yang blang mi bya/

/'khrig pa'i chos kyang mi spyod cing / /brdzun gyi tshig kyang mi smra'o/ /skyon ni mang po nyer brten pa'i/ /chang ni yongs su spang bar bya/ /khri stan mthon po mi bya zhing / /de bzhin dus ma yin pa'i zas/ /dri dang phreng ba rgyan dang ni/ /gar dang glu sogs spang bar bya/ /ji ltar dgra bcom rtag tu ni/ /srog gcod la sogs mi byed par/ /de bzhin srog gcod la sogs spangs/ /bla med byang chub myur thob shog /sdug bsngal mang 'khrugs 'jig rten 'di/ /srid pa'i mtsho las sgrol bar shog /ces lan gsum brjod/ oṃ a mo gha shī la/ sam+bha ra sam+bha ra/ bha ra bha ra/ ma hā shūd+dha satwa pad+ma bi bhu ṣi ta bhu dza/ dha ra dha ra/ sa man+ta a ba lo ki te hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ zhes nyer gcig bzlas nas/ badz+ra muḥ tshogs zhing rnams rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs par gyur/ ces brjod do/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ de nas phyag 'tshal skyes bu dpa' khyod la sogs nas/ bzlas pa bsdu ba'i bar sngar bzhin bya/ de nas dkyil 'khor 'bri bar 'gyur ba'i bar gtor ma gcig la chab bran/ bsangs sbyangs stong pa'i ngang las rin po che'i snod du gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ yul grong gnas gzhi'i bdag po sa pa ri wā ra a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ oṃ yul bdag grong bdag gnas bdag gzhi bdag gnyug mar gnas pa sarba sa pa ri wā ra oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sogs gsum/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe hūm̐/ de bzhin du/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke gan+dhe/ nai wit+ya hūm̐/ gang yang 'dir gnas lha dang klu/ /gnod sbyin srin po'am ni gzhan/ /de dag rnams la sa 'di ni/ /bdag zhu khyed kyis bstsal du gsol/ /ar+ghaṃ swāhā/ sarba swas+d+ya nam gats+tsha/ rang gi spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ snying kar hūm̐/ yang sa'i dbus su dri'i thig le la me tog tshom bu bkod la/ de'i mdun du mchod gtor bshams/ sa gzhi'i dbus su dri las sa'i lha mo ser mo rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/

phyag na bum pa thogs pa rang gi 'od kyis bskor ba/ sa gzhi nas pad+ma dkar po chig rkyang gi nang nas lus phyed phyung nas me tog tshom bu'i steng du bzhugs par gyur/ lag pa g.yas par a las dkyil 'khor gyi hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ de'i sgra dang hūm̐ gi 'od zer gyis sa 'og nas sa'i lha mo ye shes pa byung ste/ mthe bos mthe chung mnan te sa la brdabs dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dam tshig pa dang 'dres pas gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes dbang bskur bas gtso mos dbu brgyan/ mchod pas bsangs sbyangs byin rlabs dang / mi 'dra ba'i khyad par sa'i lha mo 'khor dang bcas pa'i spyan lam du 'byung zhing rgyas par gyur cig ces sbyar/ oṃ pṛ thi wī de wī sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha āḥhūm̐/ sogs/ gtor ma bsangs sbyangs byin gyis gong bzhin brlabs/ oṃ pṛ thi wī de wī sa pa ri wā ra na maḥsarba sogs gsum/ skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyis/ /spyod pa'i tshul dang khyad par dang / /sa dang pha rol phyin pa la/ /lha mo khyod ni dpang du gyur/ /skyob pa shākya seng ge yis/ /ji ltar bdud kyi dpung bcom pa/ /de bzhin bdag gis bdud kyi dpung / /bcom la dkyil 'khor bri bar bgyi/ /zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab pas/ rig sngags 'chang dkyil 'khor gyi las ci bde bar gyis shig ces gsung ste sa de nyid du thim par gyur/ de nas yungs chu thal ba byugs/ dri bzang rnams kyis dkyil 'khor gyi sa sa gzhi las g.yas skor du gtor/ yak+ṣa brjod/ gzhi stong nyid snying rje dbyer med pa'i byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin du gyur/ ma ṇi dha ri bdun bzlas/ sa phyogs 'dir bcom ldan 'das ma bsrung ba lnga'i dkyil 'khor chen po 'bri bar bya'o/ /ces brjod nas langs la/ hūm̐ zhes bskor ba tsam bya/ dkyil 'khor sgo skyong gi thig spyi dang 'dra ba btab pa'i nang du/

dbus su phur pa la btags pa'i thig skud kyis nang nas rim pa bzhin/ tshangs thig nas cha phran gnyis kyi pad+ma'i lte ba/ gcig ze'u 'bru/ gsum pad 'dab/ yang gcig ze'u 'bru/ gsum pad 'dab/ gcig 'khor lo'i rtsibs rten/ gsum rtsibs gcig mu khyud/ gcig lha snam/ phyi'i rwa rtse nas gsum pad 'dab/ gnyis rdo rwa/ bzhi 'od kyi phreng ba rnams skor thig gdab bo/ /de nas las thig rdzogs par btab grub nas/ yak+ṣas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las raṃ las nas/ gdan re re grub par gyur gyi bar mdun bskyed bzhin brjod/ de nas gtso mo lnga'i gnas su gru bzhi dang / gzhan rnams su zlum po'i dri'i thig le'i steng du/ me tog tshom bu re bkod kyin/ ma ṇi dha ri gsum/ dbus su bcom ldan 'das ma so sor 'brang ma nas/ bzhugs pa'o/ /de bzhin du re re bzhin sngags gsum gsum bzlas la lha so sor bskyed/ mtha' chod pas gru bzhir 'dod kha cig mda' yab kyi steng nas g.yas bskor ba ni bzhad gad kyi gnas so/ /snam steng nas bskor nas/ de rnams kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ snying ka'i nang du sogs nas/ spyan 'dren/ byon legs/ khrus gsol/ gdan dbul mchod pa dgug gzhug dbang bskur zhing dbu brgyan pa'i bar mdun bskyed bzhin bya/ de nas bum pa sta gon la bum pa gcig las med na sngar bstan pa ltar yin la/ spros pa la dga' bas lnga yod na/ baṃ lnga las bskyed pa'i gtso mo'i bum par lha tshogs tshang ma/ phyogs bzhi'i bum par lha mo bzhi bskyed la yan lag bzhi rdzogs pa dang / dri'i dkyil 'khor dang bum pa'i mchod bstod phyogs gcig byas nas bzlas pa dang / lha zhu ba'i bar bya/ de nas pañca rak+ṣa sogs nyer mchod kyi dris dkyil 'khor mchod/ rdor dril spos bcas dang / lce hūm̐ las skyes pa'i rdo rjer gyur/ oṃ badz+ra dzi hwa/ rig pa'i rgyal mo bcom ldan 'das/

/rig sngags rgyal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje yid kyi dkyil 'khor 'bri/ /de ltar byin rlabs gnang bar mdzod/ /dgongs shig sangs rgyas sde dang tshogs/ /gang gzhan sngags kyi lha tshogs dang / /lha rnams bstan la mngon dga' ba/ /dkyil 'khor 'di la byin rlabs dang / /dngos grub dam pa stsol bar mdzod/ /ces lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ bcom ldan 'das ma 'khor dang bcas pa sang nang par rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du spyan 'dren na 'byon par ci gnang / gnang ba chen po mdzad du gsol/ 'dir gtor ma 'bul ba dang / bden stobs chen po brjod pa sogs yod mod/ de nas zhag gis bar chod pa'i dbang du byas la/ dkyil chog 'dir de ma gsungs pas 'di kho na'o/ /oṃ badz+ra muḥsta gon gyi ye shes pa rnams rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa rnams rang la thim par gyur/ ces brjod nas/ sta gon gyi mchod pa dang / tshom bu sogs bsdus la/ rang gi mdun du tshon kha dog lnga la/ praṃ hūm̐ maṃ shaṃ gaṃ rnams bris/ de dag dang mthun pa'i ye shes kyi thig so so yang steng du bzhag la/ phyogs ma 'chol bar bkod nas/ yak+ṣas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las thig tshon dkar po praṃ las so sor 'brang ma sku mdog dkar ser sogs/ de bzhin du gdan bzhi yang bskyed la/ mig gnyis ma dang ṭa las nyi zla bskyed/ mig 'bras hūm̐ thugs las rdo rjer gyur/ oṃ dip+ta driṣ+ṭa aṃ ku sha dzaḥzhes pa'i sngags dang / rdzi ma 'gugs pa'i phyag rgyas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas ye shes kyi thig tshon bkug nas dam tshig gi thig tshon so so la thim pas ngo bo rigs lnga la rnam pa thig tshon du gyur thig skud bsgril zhing / oṃ a n+yo n+ya a nu ga tāḥ sarba dharma pa raspa ra a nu pra wiṣ+ṭaḥ sarba dharma a d+yan+ta a nu pra wiṣ+ṭaḥ sarba dharma oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rdul tshon nyed cing oṃ badz+ra tsi tra sa ma ya pra be sha ya hūm̐/ de nas tshon rnams la hrīḥbris la/

bden pa gang gis sems can rnams rdul tshon mang zhing / sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams sems can la chags pa dang / rjes su chags pa'i bden pa des rdul tshon rnams 'bar bar gyur cig hrīḥhrīḥzhes 'bar ba'i phyag rgyas sbar de nas slob dpon nub dang / grogs shar du gnas pa dzaḥ zhes thig sna slob dpon gyi g.yas kyis gtad/ grogs kyi g.yon pas drangs shing / dzaḥdzaḥdzaḥzhes brjod de yang / nub dang lhor gnas tshangs thig gnyis/ /me rlung de nyid mer gnas pa/ /shar nub byang lho'i rtsa thig gdab/ /de nyid dang ni bden bral du/ gnas pas zur thig gnyis po gdab/ /slob dpon 'dug pa'i dbang du byas/ /slob ma de las ldog pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ dang por nam mkha' la se gol gyi sgra dang bcas pas dkyus thig gdab/ de nas sa la gdab cing / sems can don du dus yin gyi/ /de phyir khyod rnams 'dir byon cig /oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya sū tra mā ti kra ma hūm̐/ zhes brjod/ btab tshar nas nyer mchod kyis mchod/ oṃ badz+ra muḥ thig gi ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la thim/ oṃ badz+ra be ga a kra ma hūm̐/ zhes dbus su phyin nas/ kro dha ḍīka ṭi hrīḥ gsum gsum gyis sgo'i thad kyi rtsa thig dbye/ rang gi mig las rdo rje 'phros pas thar pa'i sgo'i bar chad thams cad bcom par gyur/ ces brjod nas phyir don no/ /de nas dkyil 'khor 'bri ba ni/ dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma ze'u 'bru dang bcas pa nyis rim/ 'khor lo sngon po/ rtsibs mchan phyogs mdog rtsibs rten dang mu khyud nag po lha snam sngon po phyogs mdog lha'i kha dog dang mtshungs pa/ gdan spyi dang 'dra bar bris la/ tshon lhag ma la mchod/ ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa bsdus/ dkyil 'khor gyi mtha' dris byugs/ de'i phyi nas tshon skud kyi dra ba dang / mchod gtor sngar bzhin las/ rgyas par byed na rgyal chen bzhi'i gtor ma phyogs bzhir bshams/

bum pa lnga yod na gtso mo'i bum pa mchod bcom ldan 'das ma'i dbu thog gi mchod rten du dmigs la/ rten dang bcas nas/ shar gyi bum pa'i g.yas su bde dga' rgya mtsho las dbus mañji'i steng du gtso mo'i bum pa bzhag de'i steng du me long la gur gum gyis ma ṇi dha ri bris pa dang byang chub chen po'i mchod rten dang dung chos kyi chu la u da ka bzlas pa dang / rdor dril la me tog gi zug ma btags pa rnams bzhag zhes gsungs pas 'grub na de bzhin bya'o/ /bshams na sbyin sreg dbang bskur ba sogs la gdan 'dren pa stabs bde bas legs gsungs/ gzhan yang 'grub na/ grogs gso sbyong blangs pa lngas/ shar du stong chen dang so 'brang gnyis/ lhor rma bya chen mo/ nub tu gsang sngags rjes 'dzin/ byang du bsil ba'i tshal rnams dpe 'di rnams bshams kyang rung / bklag go /de nas sang nang par gso sbyong blang ba nas bdag bskyed bsdu ba'i bar byas/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor bsangs sbyangs nas/ rang rang gi sngags bdun bdun gyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i bar ras bris bzhin bum pa lnga yod na phyogs kyi bzhir lha mo bzhir bskyed/ gzhan mchod bstod gtor ma sogs 'dra/ chu'i sbyin sreg byed na/ gtso mo'i bum pa bsangs sbyangs nas bzung / dbu brgyan pa'i bar bum sgrub kyi skabs ltar byas nas/ mchod bstod mdor bsdus dang / phyogs skyong gza' rgyu skar rgyal chen rnams kyi bstod pa bsdus pa gong bdag 'jug gi mgo bzhin/ rgya gar nas me tog kun da la byed/ bod du me tog dkar po'am/ mchod pa bsangs sbyangs byin rlabs/ 'bul tshul tshogs zhing gi skabs ltar la rol chen/ gtso mo lnga'i bstod pa bdag bskyed bzhin dang / yang na 'bras sam nas dkar mo bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las kuṃ las byung ba'i kun+ta'i phung pos/ nad gdon bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs sel ba'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/

oṃ ma ṇi sogs nas/ ru ru tsā le swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ rdo rje'i slob ma 'di rnams kyi sdig sgrib nad gdon bgegs dang bar du gcod pa thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru ye swāhā/ nyer gcig gam brgya rtsa/ oṃ in+d+ra ye nas/ de wi swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe nas/ ku ru ye swāhā/ bdun/ de bzhin du/ gza' rnams la༞ rgyu skar rnams la༞ rgyal chen bzhi la༞ yang dur mon phan chad la skye ste rtsa ba sran ma 'dra lo ma bra bo 'dra ba la dur ba zer/ bod na zor ba'i rtsa ba la byed pa mthun gsungs wa bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las duṃ las dur wa gzhon nu tshe dang bsod nams 'phel ba'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ oṃ ma ṇi sogs gong bzhin sngags rnams sbrel ba'i rjes su/ oṃ badz+ra a yuḥṣe swāhā/ rdo rje'i slob ma'am sbyin pa'i bdag po'i tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor thams cad puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru ye oṃḥ de bzhin du/ phyogs skyong nas rgyal chen bzhi'i bar la gong bzhin phul lo/ /de nas mchod bstod mdor bsdus dang / bcom ldan 'das ma bum pa'i lha tshogs nas/ gzhal yas khang zhu nas bum par gyur gyi bar bya/ de nas phyogs bzhi'i gtor ma dang / bdag 'jug dang / slob ma la byab tshul sogs sngar bzhin no/ /gsum pa rjes ni/ de yang sgrub mchod sbrel nas byed na/ zhag snga ma rnams la bdag bskyed nas brtan bzhugs bsngo ba'i bar ras bris dang rdul mtshon gyi dkyil 'khor la brtan par bzhugs su gsol sogs cung zad re 'don pa spo ba las gzhan khyad par med la/ zhag rjes ma la/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyi rjes su/ khyed kyi sems can don kun mdzad sogs dang / badz+ra muḥ rdul tshon gyi ye shes pa rnams gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la thim/ de nas a kā ro brjod cing lha'i mtshan ma rnams mas rim nas bsdu thig rjes bsubs/ bkra shis rgyas par bya ba sogs sngar bstan pa ltar bya'o/ /de ltar gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi phan yon/

lo rgyus dang bcas pa ni gzungs kyi mdo rnams su gsal zhing / gzhan mdo'i rjes su 'brangs pa'i bsrung 'khor 'bri thabs/ tshe brtag pa/ bum chog rgyas pa/ sbyin sreg rgyas pa/ las chog so so dang bcas pa ni/ gzhan du blta'o/ /de lta'i legs bshad mchod sbyin brgya yis legs bskrun pa/ /gzungs dang rtogs pa rgya bod gsung rab sum rtsen la/ /dbang bsgyur lung rig gser gyi rdo rje'i phyag mtshan can/ /bla ma'i phyag len mig stong ldan pa'i brgya byin no/ /grwa lnga'i lha mo dga' mgur spyod 'dod nye dbang rnams/ /gus pas 'di nyid skabs gsum dbang po bzhin du bsten/ /bya spyod grong khyer lta na sdug nas phal cher gyis/ /lag len lha yi bu mo kun la rol bar nges/ /gang gi lhag bsam nor bu chu shel ni/ /'jam dar la brgyus dbyangs can lha mo de'i/ /do shal rgyal ba'i thugs mtshan se mo do/ /'di las skye dgu'i rgyan kun 'byung ba mtshar/ /lhan thabs mkhas pa'i mgul rgyan 'di/ /dman pa dag gi gtsug rgyan rigs/ /'di ni sku zhang chos kyi rje/ /bsod nams mtshan can bkas bskul nas/ /dge slong 'jam dbyangs zhes bya ba/ /bstan pa'i mnga' bdag mkhyen rab rje'i/ /gsung las skyes pa'i gsungs bzhin sbyar/ /nyes pa med sems mchis na bshags/ /'di sbyar dge bas lam gsum pa/ /thams cad 'gro ba'i rang bzhin mchog /bla med byang chub chen po'i mtsho/ /'gro ba kun gyis thob par shog /ces bcom ldan 'das ma srung ba lnga'i dkyil chog nag 'gros ma 'di ni sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos rang gzhan la phan pa'i sems kyis kun slong rnam par dag pa'i sgo nas sbyar ba 'di'i yig gzhi ni thugs sras rin chen rnam rgyal gyis mdzad pa'i dkyil chog bde dga' rgya mtsho/ de'i lhan thabs bco brgyad 'jam dbyangs rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i mkhas pa'i mgul rgyan gnyis lhan cig tu bsdebs te nag 'gros dkyus gcig tu bkod pa de dag tu mi gsal ba rnams zha lu slob dpon drug gis brtsam pa'i gdugs dkar nyer bdun ma'i dkyil chog nas kha bskangs te don la rang bzo'i dri ma cung zad kyang ma gos par sbyar ba yin zhing /
